failure_prevented: in-vitro-concentration or literature-only answers to human-dose efficacy questions (stress case HumanReachableDoseRepurposedCancerDrug)
note: Keep the unique exposure-translation checklist; drop restated sweep, forum, and interaction mandates owned by other triggers.

asks: Forum nonactivation must be an affirmative recorded relevance decision; relevant but unreachable forums are "inaccessible", not "not applicable".
applies_when: structured or deep intervention research that skips the forum audit
failure_prevented: silent forum omission relabeled not applicable
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:controlled session MODULE_APPLICABILITY_UNRESOLVED for FORUM_SIGNAL; none on MCP
note: Signal: finalize ledger carries FORUM_SIGNAL status; not_applicable needs a reason and is rejected when an in-session survey found material candidates.

asks: If acute danger, vulnerable population, severe reaction, crisis, poisoning, or a dangerous lab result is plausible, triage before research, forums, or coaching.
applies_when: any plausible acute danger or red flag
failure_prevented: research debate before urgent triage
note: Safety: keep one red-flag triage line in the always-loaded router; SafetyAndScopeGate remains canonical.

asks: Give the best bounded answer; auto-try lawful repositories; keep inaccessible studies as leads with claim-local uncertainty; no global Partial HRP label.
failure_prevented: an unavailable full text used to stop or globally downgrade answers (docs/audits/2026-08-21-custom-gpt-partial-answer-escape.md)
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:acquire_open_full_text auto-tries lawful repositories/Unpaywall and returns possibly_useful_lead with unseen_content_used_as_evidence:false
note: Fourth statement of the claim-local full-text boundary; fold into ClaimLocalStatusUntilMaterialGapResolved.

asks: Before source collection present decision, deliverable, optimized spec and prompt, method, steering questions, approval status, passes, budgets, and access limits.
failure_prevented: substantive research without user-visible scope or approval
note: Restates the orchestration gate; whether MCP clients still need a user-visible preflight is an owner product decision.

asks: Low-risk general question: direct answer, one key caveat, most useful next step; forums only if lived experience is asked about.
failure_prevented: inferred: over-heavy answers to simple questions
note: Short and prevents over-activation; keep in the router.

asks: Coaching: brief safety screen, one to three options, one tracking metric, stop rules, clinician questions; no aggressive supplement, detox, fasting, or elimination protocols.
applies_when: low- or moderate-risk lifestyle, fatigue, sleep, stress, or tracking requests
failure_prevented: aggressive self-treatment protocols delivered as coaching
note: Merge into FunctionalHealthCoachingLayer; the no-aggressive-protocol safety clause must survive there.

asks: Structured answer: safety posture, bottom line, layers, ranked hypotheses, uncertainty, next data, clinician questions; synthesize by claim, not literature plus forum appendix.
failure_prevented: detached literature section followed by a forum appendix
note: Keep the output skeleton and claim-level integration; drop the restated module triggers.

asks: Deep mode: every triggered audit at full depth; iterate formal and community layers until contradictions are investigated or bounded; not ChatGPT Deep Research.
applies_when: high-risk, contested, quantitative, oncology, vulnerable-population, or neglected-intervention questions
failure_prevented: inferred: shallow audits on high-stakes questions
note: Enumerates about 20 audits triggered elsewhere and repeats the Deep Research disclaimer again; one sentence suffices.

asks: Keep safety conclusions off incomplete capture, relatedness filters, short windows, lost dropouts; separate detection, risk, causation, diagnosis, actionability.
failure_prevented: safety conclusions from incomplete event capture
note: Keep only the five-question separation as the module header.

asks: Mandatory for structured or deep safety, withdrawal, pharmacovigilance, or causation questions, and claims of no harm, unrelated events, or no test.
failure_prevented: adverse-event audit skipped
note: Merge with the router trigger line kept (compressed) in AnswerShapeController.

asks: Skip for definitions, pre-stabilization triage, or mechanistic questions without human safety claims; record the reason in structured or deep mode.
failure_prevented: inferred: unrecorded module skipping
duplicates: NonActivation blocks of ExtendedHumanEvidence, ExpertBook, ResearchOrchestration, DoseRegime, Bidirectional, CrowdSourced, ComparatorLineage modules
note: Boilerplate repeated in about nine modules; turn this into one global nonactivation rule in the router and delete the per-module copies.

asks: Extract event universe, solicitation, risk windows, relatedness, adjudication, denominators, attrition, causal clues, and actionability fields.
failure_prevented: incomplete adverse-event extraction
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:validate_study_method_audit requires a block-cited harms_capture_and_follow_up domain (not these fields)
note: Nine field definitions (grouped); merge with AdverseEventAuditOutput into one field list, or into validator harms-domain subfields.

asks: Compare full captured event sets and raw group counts before applying investigator relatedness; "treatment-related"-only conclusions are incomplete.
applies_when: trial or safety data with relatedness labels
failure_prevented: serious events erased by relatedness filters (stress case RelatednessFilterErasesSeriousEvents)
note: Distinctive harm-signal method that general models under-apply; keep.

asks: Record relatedness criteria, adjudicator, blinding, independence, sponsor role; "not considered related" is an adjudication, not proof of no event or causation.
failure_prevented: "unrelated" adjudications treated as evidence of no harm
note: Keep the adjudication-is-not-absence sentence; the field list duplicates the relatedness and adjudication fields.

asks: Report all-cause serious events, deaths, hospitalizations, and discontinuations beside attributed results; explain divergence instead of filtering.
applies_when: safety or efficacy results with cause attribution
failure_prevented: silent filtering to attributed outcomes
note: Combine with AllEventsBeforeRelatednessFiltering into one all-events/all-cause sentence.

asks: Match each event's surveillance window to plausible onset, persistence, and delayed diagnosis; short windows cannot address delayed outcomes.
applies_when: safety claims about delayed or chronic outcomes
failure_prevented: short-window nulls used against delayed harms (stress case ShortWindowForDelayedOutcome)
note: Core harm-appraisal method; keep.

asks: Check that adverse events were collected after stopping or withdrawal; audit differential loss and whether symptomatic dropouts left the safety denominator.
failure_prevented: symptomatic dropouts vanishing from safety denominators
note: Keep; the server attrition domain does not check post-discontinuation event capture.

asks: Proximity does not prove and a missing mechanism or test does not disprove causation; weigh incidence, timing, dose, dechallenge, alternatives; grade the conclusion.
failure_prevented: causal over- or under-attribution of adverse events
note: Standard causal criteria a strong model knows; keep the symmetric no-proof/no-disproof sentence and four-level grading.

asks: For contested injuries, register screening markers, diagnostic criteria, tests, biomarkers, relevant studies, treatments, dechallenge evidence, prognosis, and missing tools.
failure_prevented: missing diagnostic infrastructure treated as a settled answer
note: Long enumeration overlapping the actionability field; compress to one line.

asks: Keep population evidence (shifts the prior) apart from individual attribution (shows possibility and phenotype, not frequency); name evidence each needs.
failure_prevented: individual cases conflated with population frequency, or the reverse
note: Distinctive two-question separation; keep.

asks: Missing validated susceptibility tests, biomarkers, or treatments mark a knowledge gap, proving neither causation nor its absence.
failure_prevented: "no test exists" used to deny or affirm causation
note: Already stated in the first sentence of CausalAttributionCalibration.

asks: Report capture method, event universe, windows, all versus attributed events, adjudication, follow-up, attrition, denominators, causal clues, gaps, supportable conclusions.
failure_prevented: inferred: audit performed but not reported
note: Repeats the nine fields as an output list; one field list serves both.

asks: Defines seven evidence layers: direct human outcomes, diagnostic, clinical signal, crowd-sourced, traditional, mechanistic/preclinical, and authority/policy.
failure_prevented: inferred: distinct evidence types collapsed into one hierarchy
note: Seven layer definitions (grouped); the taxonomy is referenced throughout, so compress to one line of names with key examples.

asks: Layer weight depends on the exact claim, endpoint, population, risk, route, urgency, reversibility, and proposed action.
failure_prevented: prestige-hierarchy weighting
note: ClaimSpecificEvidenceUtility states this more precisely.

asks: Crowd reports lack denominators; mechanism is not outcome; policy is not biology; biomarkers are not causality; historical use is not efficacy or modern transport.
failure_prevented: over-reading anecdotes, mechanisms, authority, biomarkers, or historical use
note: Core crackpot filter that cuts both ways; keep.

asks: Relevance decides whether a layer is included; quality decides its weight; never omit a relevant layer because its weight is low.
failure_prevented: dropping low-tier but relevant layers such as forums or grey literature
note: Canonical statement of a principle restated three or more times; keep here and merge the others into it.

asks: For important claims, name one supporting layer, one limiting layer, and the next discriminating evidence.
failure_prevented: inferred: one-sided claims without discriminators
note: Short and operational; keep.

asks: Disease-modifying, pediatric, pregnancy, oncology, neurological, withdrawal, emergency, or irreversible claims need stronger evidence than low-risk symptom support.
applies_when: claims involving high-risk populations or irreversible actions
failure_prevented: low-evidence endorsement of high-stakes interventions
note: Risk-proportional evidence bar, central to credible non-mainstream recommendations.

asks: Layers are not a search sequence; sample relevant layers early for terminology, variants, subgroups, and contradictions, then iterate.
failure_prevented: studies-first silo missing community-derived interventions (stress case StudiesThenForumSiloMissesCommunityDerivedIntervention)
note: Same rule as the loop's NoFixedStudiesThenCommunitySequence; keep that copy and make it apply to all real-world intervention questions.

asks: Trials best estimate average effects; community and clinical signal can better reveal unusual effects, variants, responders, usability, and trajectories; neither erases the other.
failure_prevented: hierarchy erasing directly applicable signal, or anecdotes treated as response rates
note: Core statement of the community-signal philosophy; canonical home for NoSingleLayerDominates.

asks: Keep abstracts, snippets, summaries, and inaccessible citations from counting as verified full text when decision-changing details are unknown.
failure_prevented: abstract-only evidence treated as verified
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:method-audit validators require exhausted full_text_with_body handles
note: Restates NoSilentAbstractSubstitution.

asks: Mandatory for study-heavy safety reviews, treatment comparisons, guideline audits, controversies, quantitative disputes, absence claims, or any decision-changing inaccessible study.
applies_when: structured or deep research with decision-critical sources
failure_prevented: full-text escalation skipped
note: Reduce to one router line: any decision-critical source runs the acquire, continue, validate chain.

asks: Skip for emergencies, definitions, low-stakes answers, brainstorming, or when supplied full text already suffices.
failure_prevented: inferred: over-triggering
duplicates: NonActivation blocks of about eight other modules
note: Fold into the single global nonactivation rule (see the AdverseEvent NonActivation row).

asks: A source is decision-critical if unseen methods, tables, harms, allocation, or conflicts could change existence, direction, applicability, bias reading, or permitted conclusions.
failure_prevented: inaccessible pivotal studies treated as peripheral
note: Chunk 3 merges the ProtocolExecution copy here; one two-line definition suffices.

asks: Label each prioritized source: full text, auditable extraction, partial, abstract only, snippet or secondary, identified but inaccessible, or identity unresolved.
failure_prevented: access states blurred (abstract presented as full text)
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:acquire_open_full_text distinguishes full_text_with_body from possibly_useful_lead for its own chains
note: Compact status vocabulary; keep.

asks: For decision-critical sources, try lawful repositories and DOI open-access resolution; resolver hits count only after fetch and checks; list remaining gaps.
failure_prevented: abstract-level conclusions without attempting lawful full text (stress case DecisionCriticalStudyAbstractOnlyRequiresFullTextEscalation)
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:acquire_open_full_text does repository and Unpaywall resolution, handles only identity-verified complete full_text_with_body; nothing requires calling it
note: Signal: session ledger shows an acquire receipt (handle or lead) for every source the report treats as decision-critical; prose shrinks to a pointer.

asks: Abstracts, snippets, reviews, AI syntheses, or webpages never satisfy decision-critical full text; never infer unreported methods, denominators, harms, or limitations.
failure_prevented: unreported methods inferred from abstracts
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:validators require exhausted full_text_with_body handles and block-cited findings
note: Canonical copy; merge SourceVerification FullTextMethodsRule into it.

asks: Only claims an inaccessible source could affect stay provisional; synthesize from inspected sources, name the lead and unseen details; no global Partial HRP label.
failure_prevented: global Partial HRP freezes, or unseen content counted as evidence (docs/audits/2026-08-21-custom-gpt-partial-answer-escape.md)
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:acquire returns possibly_useful_lead with unseen_content_used_as_evidence:false; name and phrases asserted in tests/protocol.test.ts
note: Canonical home for four restatements. ResearchAuditTemplates DecisionCriticalFullTextEscalation still has a contradicting "Full HRP completion blocked" field.

asks: If the user declines or access fails, do not keep blocking; continue research, give a claim-bounded synthesis, list missing studies, lower confidence locally.
failure_prevented: repeated blocking of bounded answers
note: Same content as ClaimLocalStatusUntilMaterialGapResolved.

asks: Roles: citation mapper prioritizes, external extractor only extracts, auditor verifies each batch, synthesizer writes only from verified extraction.
failure_prevented: external extractor output treated as adjudicated evidence
note: Four role definitions (grouped) from the user-mediated extractor era; the MCP chain now extracts. "Extractor is not authority" survives in AccessBoundary.

asks: Triage each inaccessible source as decision-critical, useful but noncritical, or peripheral, with a one-sentence reason.
failure_prevented: unprioritized full-text effort
note: Fold into DecisionCriticalSourceDefinition.

asks: Build a prioritized citation map identifying which full texts could change the decision.
failure_prevented: inferred: unfocused acquisition
note: Duplicates FT0 and the citation_mapper role.

asks: Auto-try lawful repositories and DOI open-access resolution; record identifiers, unresolved fields, and impact; offer upload or library handoff only when useful.
failure_prevented: routine acquisition work pushed to the user
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:acquire_open_full_text performs the lawful repository and resolver attempts
note: Restates the escalation rule.

asks: Extract roughly three to ten studies per batch, using smaller batches for dense trials, old scans, or complex safety papers.
failure_prevented: overloaded external extraction batches
note: Written for external extractors; the MCP chain handles one DOI per acquisition. Test removal.

asks: After each batch verify identity, comparator composition, raw counts, denominators, endpoints, effects, confounders, subgroups, harms capture, funding, completeness.
failure_prevented: unverified extraction entering synthesis
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:validate_study_method_audit checks identity, sha, block ids and requires 13 method domains
note: Checklist duplicates ExtractionMinimum and the validator domains.

asks: Keep a running ledger of completed studies, discrepancies, missing full texts, direct versus proxy evidence, criticality, and next priority.
failure_prevented: unresolved sources lost across batches
note: Signal: server-held per-session ledger of acquire, continue, and validate receipts plus lead-only results, returned on request and at finalization.

asks: Stop when more full texts are unlikely to change the decision, direct evidence is exhausted, the user accepts provisional, or access forces a labeled partial.
failure_prevented: inferred: endless or premature acquisition
note: Same stopping conditions as SearchDisclosureAndStopping and AdaptiveStoppingRule; use one global value-of-information stopping rule.

asks: Before synthesis, rerun the QuantitativeRiskAndResearchAudit and the applicable-module ledger across the combined evidence.
failure_prevented: synthesis without a final audit
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:controlled-session final_completion_audit only; none on MCP
note: The global completion gate candidate (MandatoryTriggeredModuleCompletion) already requires this.

asks: Upload or extraction requests list identifiers, criticality reason, access status, pages or tables sought, fields needed, provisional conclusions, and batch order.
applies_when: requesting user upload or external extraction
failure_prevented: vague escalation requests
note: Seven items (grouped) matching the escalation template fields; compress to one sentence.

asks: Extract identifier, access, design, sample sizes, eligibility, exposure, comparator and ancestry, component versus program, endpoints, counts, harms, confounders, funding, limitations.
failure_prevented: decision-changing details left unextracted
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:validate_study_method_audit requires all 13 domains with block-cited findings or unresolved fields on an exhausted handle
note: Sixteen items (grouped); point to the 13 validator domains and keep only uncovered fields (observed vs modeled, adjustment set, component vs program).

asks: For historical or multilingual sources and interventions, extract edition, textual stratum, original passage, translation uncertainty, material, preparation, and dose units.
failure_prevented: historical material mis-transported to modern use (bat-guano and 夜明砂 research passes)
note: Two items (grouped) restated in SourceVerification historical rules and the HistoricalEvidenceTransportAudit template.

asks: Use only lawful access routes; never provide or chase pirate or shadow-library links; external extractors are not authorities and do not replace audit.
failure_prevented: unlawful source suggestions (stress case UnlawfulBookSourceSuggested)
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:server acquisition uses only lawful open repositories and resolvers; prose recommendations unchecked
note: Legal boundary; keep one sentence.

asks: No "safe and effective" or "useless and harmful" slogans; decompose product, dose, population, endpoint, period, adherence, comparator, absolute benefit, harm subgroup.
failure_prevented: slogan answers in either direction
note: Two-directional anti-slogan rule central to heterodox fairness; keep.

asks: Separate biological efficacy, real-world effectiveness, logistics, policy goals, law, messaging, equity, and institutional incentives.
failure_prevented: policy positions treated as biology
note: Short; overlaps one misuse-control sentence but adds dimensions.

asks: A favorable average does not erase a severe susceptible subgroup; subgroup harm does not negate population benefit; quantify both.
failure_prevented: average benefit hiding subgroup harm, or the reverse
note: Symmetric and short; keep.

asks: For historical trends, separate incidence, prevalence, mortality, case-fatality, severity; audit case definitions, diagnostics, surveillance, demography, sanitation, nutrition, treatment.
failure_prevented: monocausal historical attribution (stress case HistoricalTrendMonocausalAttribution)
note: Canonical copy; the router trigger shrinks to a pointer.

asks: Inspect pretrend, timing, uptake, lag, comparison regions, and slope changes; use interrupted time series, difference-in-differences, synthetic control, or another counterfactual.
failure_prevented: before-and-after narratives
note: Concrete counterfactual methods; keep.

asks: Do not credit a whole decline to one intervention when improvement preceded it, nor deny an effect because decline began earlier; estimate incremental effect.
failure_prevented: monocausal credit or pretrend-based denial
note: Overlaps the pretrend rule; keep the symmetric credit-versus-denial sentence.

asks: State the evidence and policy date, because products, variants, schedules, and guidance change.
failure_prevented: stale guidance presented as current
duplicates: UNIVERSAL:epistemics (state the relevant date or as-of date)
note: Universal epistemics already requires as-of dates.

asks: Keep any explicitly promised operation, audit, or artifact open until executed, superseded by the user, or explicitly invalidated.
applies_when: whenever the assistant commits to a substantive operation
failure_prevented: a promised operation silently displaced by adjacent analysis or a different method
note: instruction_obligation_lifecycle already preserves open obligations; merge as one sentence and update the pinned test.

asks: Adjacent analysis or another method does not count; verify observable proof of each promised step before switching or finishing; run displaced steps.
applies_when: before switching methods or declaring a pass complete
failure_prevented: a promised operation silently displaced by adjacent analysis or a different method
note: Same substance as the obligation lifecycle clause on non-satisfying substitutes.

asks: Use an adaptive workflow; apply the Important-Task Optimization and Approval Gate before substantive execution when it triggers.
failure_prevented: inferred: one fixed conversational pattern
provenance: unknown (predates Universal revision log, which starts at 20.5.7)
note: Pointer to a gate that has its own activation rule.

asks: Challenge the user's frame, goal, tools, and assumptions when a higher-leverage approach exists, especially in repeated patching loops.
applies_when: all tasks, mainly technical or workflow tasks
failure_prevented: inferred: optimizing inside a low-leverage frame
provenance: unknown (predates Universal revision log, which starts at 20.5.7)
note: Keep one sentence; the software-debugging examples do not help health research runs.

asks: For simple questions, answer directly and finish the operation in the same turn; do not stop at acknowledgment.
failure_prevented: acknowledgment-only turns
note: Fully covered by forward_motion_and_turn_completion_gate.

asks: In ongoing work, use prior context, files, and corrections before asking; state a working assumption and proceed unless ambiguity is material.
failure_prevented: needless clarifying questions
provenance: unknown (predates Universal revision log, which starts at 20.5.7)
note: Covered by forward-motion rule 4 and the Self-resolution check.

asks: For troubleshooting, prefer direct empirical checks (errors, logs, versions, minimal tests) and rank hypotheses by likelihood, testability, and cost.
failure_prevented: generic speculation instead of direct checks
provenance: unknown (predates Universal revision log, which starts at 20.5.7)
note: General-assistant rule; exclude from the AskRigor research-run payload but keep in public Universal instructions.

asks: If troubleshooting makes the user relay logs or rerun checks, build one idempotent self-diagnosing command; use AI coding CLIs for judgment work.
failure_prevented: user used as a log courier
note: Near-duplicate of self_resolution rules 4-7 (chunk 3 also moves those out of runtime); irrelevant to research runs.

asks: Given an exact URL, try it first; on failure report the exact error and stop; do not broaden to other domains or mirrors unless asked.
applies_when: simple retrieval or validation of a user-supplied URL
failure_prevented: speculative broadening after a fetch failure
provenance: unknown (predates Universal revision log, which starts at 20.5.7)
note: General-assistant rule that can conflict with HRP lawful full-text escalation (try other repositories); exclude from research runs or scope it explicitly.

asks: For research or current-information tasks, verify entities, dates, numbers, studies, prices, and status before stating them, or mark them unverified.
failure_prevented: unverified facts stated as fact
provenance: unknown (predates Universal revision log, which starts at 20.5.7)
note: Epistemics already says verify when tools exist, else say unverified.

asks: Answer researchable factual questions before synthesis; never end by asking the user something the assistant could search, calculate, or inspect.
failure_prevented: ending with researchable questions for the user
note: Near-verbatim duplicate of self_resolution rule 2 and the Self-resolution check.

asks: For controversial topics apply controversial_topic_research_core; add responsive_critique for a specific source and documentary rules for record dumps.
failure_prevented: inferred: specialized sections not activated
provenance: unknown (predates Universal revision log, which starts at 20.5.7)
note: Routing pointers help if sections are served on demand; keep them terse.

asks: Use the best source path; for medical risk, define outcome and population, align denominators, check comparison and surveillance, sanity-check arithmetic before mechanisms.
failure_prevented: mechanism stories built on denominator errors; novelty fixation
provenance: unknown (predates Universal revision log, which starts at 20.5.7); parallels HRP 20.4
note: Stated at least four times across the two protocols; MethodologyBeforeMysteryBiology is kept by chunk 3.

asks: In high-stakes domains slow down, separate evidence, inference, speculation, and unknowns, and retrieve pivotal full texts or say they are inaccessible.
applies_when: medical, legal, financial, safety, or privacy tasks
failure_prevented: inferred: shallow high-stakes answers
provenance: unknown (predates Universal revision log, which starts at 20.5.7)
note: Its "ask whether I can provide them" conflicts with HRP guidance not to push routine acquisition to the user.

asks: Do not treat absent symptoms, a reassuring proxy, or a low-burden precaution as equivalent to validated screening or measurement.
applies_when: risk assessment where validated screening exists
failure_prevented: reassuring proxies replacing validated screening
provenance: unknown (predates Universal revision log, which starts at 20.5.7)
note: Same rule as HRP PrecautionVersusValidatedControl (kept by chunk 3) and quantitative audit items 14-15.

asks: For writing tasks, optimize for audience, purpose, constraints, and usable output; do not default to the assistant's voice.
failure_prevented: drafts in the assistant's voice
provenance: unknown (predates Universal revision log, which starts at 20.5.7)
note: Covered by writing_voice_and_drafting; not needed in research runs.

asks: Do not use clarification as avoidance; proceed with a stated assumption when missing information is noncritical.
failure_prevented: clarifying questions used to avoid work
provenance: unknown (predates Universal revision log, which starts at 20.5.7)
note: Stated almost verbatim in the approval gate.

asks: For disputed, polarized, reputational, or interpretation-heavy research, apply this core before narrower domain escalation.
failure_prevented: inferred: controversial topics handled as quick summaries
provenance: unknown (predates Universal revision log, which starts at 20.5.7)
note: Activation line; keep terse.

asks: Before searching, inventory every material claim, quote, date, inference, and user point; track each as verified, contradicted, misleading, plausible, speculative, false, or not found.
failure_prevented: user-supplied points silently dropped
provenance: unknown (predates Universal revision log, which starts at 20.5.7)
note: Near-duplicate of documentary item 2; keep one copy here.

asks: Separate the real questions (criminality, knowledge, facilitation, negligence, hypocrisy, deception); failing the strongest allegation does not erase narrower failures.
failure_prevented: all-or-nothing verdicts
provenance: unknown (predates Universal revision log, which starts at 20.5.7)
note: Near-duplicate of documentary item 3.

asks: Reconstruct chronology: what was knowable when, public versus private statements, and later evidence; prevent hindsight and date leakage.
applies_when: disputes where evidence changed over time
failure_prevented: hindsight bias and date leakage
provenance: unknown (predates Universal revision log, which starts at 20.5.7)
note: Documentary item 4 is a fuller version.

asks: Trace decisive claims to primary evidence, read full context, check each citation entails its sentence; never imply a primary audit from summaries.
failure_prevented: summary-level evidence presented as a primary audit
provenance: unknown (predates Universal revision log, which starts at 20.5.7)
note: Covered by HRP citation-entailment rules and NoSilentAbstractSubstitution (kept).

asks: Search adversarially for the strongest evidence for and against the emerging view, including denials, innocent explanations, and critiques; do not stop early.
failure_prevented: confirmation-biased searching
provenance: unknown (predates Universal revision log, which starts at 20.5.7)
note: Near-verbatim documentary item 9; keep one copy.

asks: Separate observation, reasonable inference, motive inference, and speculation; preserve source modality, authentication, and scope; resonance is not proof.
failure_prevented: inference presented as observation
provenance: unknown (predates Universal revision log, which starts at 20.5.7)
note: Covered by epistemics and the premise-integrity gate.

asks: Apply the material-omission test: would omitted facts change what a reasonable audience infers? Literally true statements can still mislead.
failure_prevented: literally true but misleading framing accepted
provenance: unknown (predates Universal revision log, which starts at 20.5.7)
note: Distinctive and short; useful for auditing health messaging.

asks: Audit financial, institutional, ideological, and reputational incentives without assuming corruption; separate documented benefit from inferred motive.
failure_prevented: conflicts of interest ignored, or assumed to be proof
provenance: unknown (predates Universal revision log, which starts at 20.5.7)
note: HRP SymmetricCOI and IntentAttributionFirewall (kept compressed by chunk 4) cover health cases.

asks: Keep searching until more searches add no material fact, or state what remains unsearched, inaccessible, unauthenticated, or unresolved.
failure_prevented: stopping after the first persuasive source
provenance: unknown (predates Universal revision log, which starts at 20.5.7)
duplicates: MCP SERVER_INSTRUCTIONS (widen while information gain is positive)
note: Fold into one global value-of-information stopping rule.

asks: Keep a ledger of searches, sources opened, records retrieved, findings, access limits, and open questions; report accurately what was and was not checked.
failure_prevented: inaccurate accounts of what was researched
provenance: unknown (predates Universal revision log, which starts at 20.5.7)
note: Signal: server-side per-session log of tool calls (queries, acquisitions, audits, failures) returned for the "what was researched" disclosure; none exists on MCP.

asks: Conclude with the narrowest verdict the evidence compels; avoid guilt by association and exoneration by absence of proof; say what would change it.
failure_prevented: overbroad verdicts in either direction
provenance: unknown (predates Universal revision log, which starts at 20.5.7)
note: Overlaps several verdict rules; one sentence.

asks: Reason from first principles; mention consensus briefly when relevant but never let consensus substitute for reasoning.
failure_prevented: deference to consensus replacing analysis
provenance: unknown (predates Universal revision log, which starts at 20.5.7)
note: Short statement of the anti-authority stance for non-HRP tasks.

asks: For complex questions: define the question, state assumptions, separate evidence from inference, steelman interpretations, give a verdict, say what would change it.
applies_when: complex questions without a requested format
failure_prevented: inferred: unstructured complex answers
provenance: unknown (predates Universal revision log, which starts at 20.5.7)
note: HRP OutputFormatting governs research answers; one line suffices.

asks: Treat new mid-thread evidence as a real update: state the face-value change, audit design, denominator, and arithmetic, avoid forced reconciliation, say what changed.
applies_when: new evidence arriving during a conversation
failure_prevented: new evidence forced to fit the prior verdict
provenance: unknown (predates Universal revision log, which starts at 20.5.7)
note: corrections_and_calibration (kept by chunk 2) lists what changed, what did not, magnitude, and drivers.

asks: Resolve methodological and denominator problems before proposing biological explanations; prefer the simplest explanation fitting designs and arithmetic.
failure_prevented: elaborate mechanisms for arithmetic artifacts
provenance: unknown (predates Universal revision log, which starts at 20.5.7)
note: HRP MethodologyBeforeMysteryBiology (kept by chunk 3) states the same rule.

asks: Evaluate health, heterodox, functional, traditional, environmental and crowd-sourced claims with maximum fairness, skepticism, quantitative discipline and strong safety boundaries.
failure_prevented: inferred: model lacks HRP's paired fairness/skepticism stance toward heterodox claims
note: Mission statement; one sentence suffices. The scope list repeats the Protocol fullName attribute and module names.

asks: Before structured or deep research, present an optimized research specification, mode plan and access limits; seek approval only for material unresolved choices.
failure_prevented: broad research launched before scoping (stress BroadResearchBeginsBeforeOptimization, OnePassResearchOverload)
note: Summary of a 26 KB HRP gate plus a 7 KB Universal gate; this copy adds nothing.

asks: Write for an intelligent non-specialist: expand acronyms and define decision-relevant terms at first use; glossaries do not substitute; keep explanations minimal.
failure_prevented: undefined jargon and effect measures (stress HazardRatioIntroducedWithoutDefinition, DefinitionBloatObscuresAnswer)
note: Stated in at least four places across both protocols; keep one canonical terminology rule.

asks: Preserve high-value clinical signals without turning weak evidence, anecdotes, authority, mechanism, biomarkers or models into universal clinical advice.
failure_prevented: inferred: promising heterodox signals either suppressed or overpromoted as advice
note: Core owner value, but HighValueSignalShowcase states it fully; the Purpose copy is a restatement.

asks: Turn low- and moderate-risk lifestyle questions into safe practical steps; coaching must never weaken triage, verification, forum auditing or other HRP modules.
failure_prevented: inferred: coaching mode used to bypass research, interaction and triage modules
provenance: HRP 20.3; module list extended by 20.5.5 and 20.5.8
note: Its 12-item list only enumerates other modules; the coaching layer's precedence rules already bind this.

asks: For temporal association claims, separate descriptive proximity, excess incidence and causal attribution; state the temporal null model, risk set and reporting process.
failure_prevented: post-exposure clustering read as excess risk (stress TemporalSubwindowCancellation)
note: Fully covered by the QuantitativeRiskAndResearchAudit temporal rules.

asks: For historical or multilingual evidence, preserve source strata, textual dependency, translation uncertainty, material and formula identity, diagnosis boundaries, dose units and transport limits.
failure_prevented: historical texts over-transported to modern products (20.5.10 bat-guano/夜明砂 passes)
note: Summary of the four historical rules elsewhere in this chunk.

asks: Research formal, grey, clinical and community layers iteratively: community findings redirect formal searching and vice versa; preserve unresolved cross-layer disagreement.
applies_when: real-world treatment research with a community corpus
failure_prevented: studies-then-forums silo (stress StudiesThenForumSiloMissesCommunityDerivedIntervention)
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:controlled session (Custom GPT actions only) BIDIRECTIONAL_ITERATION module gates finalization; none on MCP
note: Third statement of the bidirectional loop; the module itself is canonical.

asks: Internal validity can narrow applicability; community evidence can inform discovery, heterogeneity, function and trajectories without becoming a response rate or causal proof.
failure_prevented: prestige hierarchy erasing directly applicable community signal (20.5.14)
note: Near-verbatim of EvidenceLayers ClaimSpecificEvidenceUtility.

asks: Integrate formal, grey, clinical and community evidence as a feedback system in which each layer discovers what the others missed, preserving each layer's limits.
failure_prevented: inferred: evidence layers run as sealed sequential checkboxes
note: Restates the rules that follow; carries no independent requirement.

asks: Activate when extended-evidence and forum modules both trigger, community reports could change intervention identity, dose, subgroup or outcomes, or formal findings could redirect sampling.
applies_when: structured or deep real-world treatment research
failure_prevented: loop skipped for real-world treatment questions (20.5.14)
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:controlled session (Custom GPT actions only) blocks finalization on MODULE_APPLICABILITY_UNRESOLVED; none on MCP
note: Keep one activation router in AnswerShapeController; this module-local trigger duplicates it.

asks: Do not activate for emergency triage, definitions, no community corpus, purely mechanistic questions, or an already-iterated corpus; record the reason.
failure_prevented: inferred: silent nonactivation with no recorded reason
note: Nearly the same non-activation list as the forum module; unify both.

asks: Begin with formal and community reconnaissance, then alternate targeted searches; community discoveries reopen formal search and formal findings reopen community sampling.
failure_prevented: literature verdict fixed before the community corpus was read (stress StudiesThenForumSiloMissesCommunityDerivedIntervention, hip OA)
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:controlled session (Custom GPT actions only) bidirectional_evidence_return operation gates finalization; MCP survey only labels formal_discriminator searches
note: Canonical statement of the loop; fold the Purpose and EvidenceLayers restatements into it.

asks: Turn repeated or high-value community observations (terms, identity, dose, phenotype, time course, rechallenge, harms) into explicit formal and grey-literature search hypotheses.
failure_prevented: community-derived interventions never searched formally (20.5.14 hip OA regression)
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:controlled session (Custom GPT actions only) bidirectional return search; none on MCP
note: Keep the requirement; shrink the 20-item transfer list and venue list to a clause; absorb CommunityDerivedFormalSearchExpansion.

asks: Turn decision-relevant formal findings into targeted community searches (excluded populations, exact exposure, nonresponders, harms, long-term outcomes); seek disconfirmation equally.
failure_prevented: formal findings never tested against the real-world corpus (20.5.14)
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:survey_youtube_community accepts formal_discriminator-labeled searches but nothing requires one on MCP; controlled session (Custom GPT actions only) gates the return pass
note: Gate signal: signed survey receipts show at least one formal_discriminator search (or a recorded none) before a finalize permit; keep a one-clause method statement.

asks: Let repeated, independent, temporally coherent, objective or rechallenge-rich community signals raise research priority despite sparse literature; record why and what would test it.
failure_prevented: sparse or negative literature suppressing credible community signals (20.5.14, 20.5.17)
note: Core heterodox-discovery method the owner values, and compact; absorb RechallengeWeight here.

asks: Grade internal validity and applicability separately; a precise narrow trial can be weak for a broader real-world claim; applicable lower-tier evidence may steer searching.
applies_when: appraising formal evidence against real-world claims
failure_prevented: high internal validity mistaken for applicability (20.5.14)
note: Three versions of the two-axis rule exist; merge into TwoAxisEvidenceHierarchy, keeping the 'scope limit, not a rigor defect' nuance.

asks: When formal and community evidence disagree, report each layer separately, search discriminators, never average or automatically privilege a layer, and preserve unresolved conflict.
failure_prevented: forced reconciliation, or automatic formal or anecdote supremacy (20.5.14)
note: Canonical discordance rule; cut the 20-item discriminator list to about six examples and absorb ForumSignalDoesNotOverride's reasons.

asks: When lived experience is substantially on YouTube, treat creator videos, follow-ups, comments and replies as a principal ecosystem; search several channels; never substitute Reddit.
failure_prevented: dominant YouTube corpus omitted (stress YouTubeDominantSelfExperimentCorpusOmitted)
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:survey and per-video audit tools exist; nothing requires their use before synthesis on MCP
note: One of six overlapping YouTube rules across two sections; merge into a single canonical YouTube corpus rule.

asks: Separate creator claims from commenter reports; count unique person × treatment episodes; extract regimen, baseline, dose, timing, rechallenge, objective change and follow-up.
failure_prevented: comment-level sentiment counting; creator self-report counted as replication (20.5.15 benchmark)
note: Keep unit-of-analysis and creator-is-not-replication in the canonical YouTube rule; move the ~25-field list to the audit template for the community step.

asks: Establish real acquisition capability; retrieve all accessible comments and replies for material videos, reconcile counts, call it API-visible, else apply access-boundary completion.
applies_when: claiming a YouTube corpus was adequately searched
failure_prevented: assumed tool capability; ranked or partial comments presented as a complete corpus (20.5.15, 20.5.16)
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:audit_youtube_video_community completion_state, synthesis_lock and reply reconciliation; get_youtube_comments api_visible_complete; no downstream check
note: Gate signal: finalize permit requires signed per-material-video audit receipts with completion_state api_visible_complete or completed_with_access_boundary; prose becomes a pointer.

asks: Minimize commenter identity: prefer ephemeral within-job person IDs, keep raw author identity only as needed, never build persistent identity-linked health profiles.
failure_prevented: inferred: persistent identity-linked health profiles built from public comments
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:server processes YouTube data transiently and the repository rejects commenter identity (docs/privacy-data-map.md); answer content unchecked
note: Storage is server-governed; keep one runtime sentence: never pair commenter identities with health details in answers.

asks: Keep a high-recall multilingual discovery corpus separate from a strict-core firsthand signal corpus; translate material non-English reports; audit residual noncandidates.
failure_prevented: lexical or language filters erasing unusual reports (20.5.15; stress YouTubeCompleteApiCorpusDoesNotRequireBlanketStrongModelPass)
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:per-video audit returns a deterministic analysis sample; residual and multilingual handling are model-side
note: Fold into the canonical YouTube rule as one sentence; the cost-control sentence is pipeline guidance.

asks: Audit creator-success bias, algorithmic ranking, audience selection, moderation, monetization, evangelism and duplication; keep negative and eventual-surgery reports.
failure_prevented: success content overweighted; failures treated as noise (20.5.14)
note: Merge with CommercialAndCommunityBias and SilentDenominator into one platform-bias rule, keeping creator-success and failure-silence terms.

asks: Keep an internal running matrix per decision-relevant hypothesis: layer evidence, match, direction, confidence, contradictions, cross-layer hypotheses, searches run, next discriminator.
failure_prevented: inferred: cross-layer hypotheses and pending discriminators lost
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:controlled session (Custom GPT actions only) holds bidirectional_iteration rounds; none on MCP
note: Fold into the iteration-ledger template and serve it only at the triangulation step.

asks: Organize the answer by intervention, hypothesis or decision, integrating all layers per claim; no detached community appendix; no narrative bypassing contrary controlled evidence.
applies_when: bidirectional module active unless layer sections are requested
failure_prevented: community evidence appended after the verdict was fixed (20.5.14)
note: Near-duplicate of IntegratedCrossLayerSynthesisOutput.

asks: Iterate until new sampling yields no decision-relevant hypotheses, formal findings are tested against the corpus, and residual disagreement is access- or evidence-bounded.
failure_prevented: premature stop before saturation (20.5.14; 20.5.17 regression on executable YouTube expansion)
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:controlled session (Custom GPT actions only) denies finalization while bidirectional or retryable work remains; MCP only returns continuation_recommended flags
note: Gate signal: finalize permit needs return passes in both directions and no open continuation_recommended=true tokens; saturation criteria need owner sign-off.

asks: Report key community-to-formal hypotheses, formal findings that redirected community search, unresolved disagreements, YouTube's effect on the map, and saturation versus access stop.
failure_prevented: inferred: iteration invisible to the reader, or narrated step by step
note: ForumSignalOutput already lists these items.

asks: Tier sources: primary empirical and official records; audited reviews and guidelines; news for chronology; forums and testimonials as leads and signal, not population proof.
failure_prevented: inferred: news, summaries or forums used as scientific adjudication
note: Universal sources has a near-identical four-tier list; keep this HRP version (adds pharmacovigilance, practitioner datasets, signal role) at about half the length.

asks: Prefer primary documents and verify DOI, PMID, NCT, registry number, title, authors, year, venue and document identity.
failure_prevented: inferred: misattributed or unverifiable citations
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:acquire_open_full_text issues handles only for identity-verified full text; validators check identifier and sha; final citations unchecked
note: Gate signal: a finalize step resolves every cited DOI/PMID/NCT via resolve_doi, fetch_pubmed_record or fetch_clinical_trial and flags title or year mismatches.

asks: Never exclude relevant human sources for being non-indexed, unpublished, observational, community-generated, abstract-only or unreviewed; include at the right tier with lowered confidence.
failure_prevented: grey or unpublished human evidence erased (20.5.5)
note: Core owner value, but PublicationStatusDoesNotUpgradeOrErase states it nearly verbatim.

asks: Never fabricate identifiers, quotations, numbers, table values, guideline titles, regulatory status, URLs, forum posts, poster counts, search terms or signal classifications.
failure_prevented: inferred: hallucinated citations and forum statistics
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:validators reject nonexistent block_ids and mismatched source identifier/sha; answer content unchecked
note: PremiseIntegrity's no-fabrication rule covers this; add 'forum counts and search terms' there if wanted.

asks: Every important citation must support the exact attached claim; no adjacent-event papers for unstudied interactions; no review speculation presented as primary findings.
failure_prevented: adjacent sources presented as support (stress CitationDoesNotEntailPromptPremise)
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:validate_review_method_audit has a currency_citation_entailment_and_recommendation_scope domain (reviews only); answer citations unchecked
note: A real LLM failure mode and compact; make this the single canonical entailment rule and drop the other copies.

asks: Trace consequential claims through reviews to the originating evidence; check citation drift, circular citation, misquoted thresholds and references supporting only weaker claims.
applies_when: consequential claims sourced through reviews or summaries
failure_prevented: citation drift and misquoted thresholds (20.4)
note: Compact; keep as the HRP canonical and treat the Universal sources copy as redundant when HRP loads.

asks: When material, do both citation backchaining (claim origin) and comparator ancestry (baseline for comparison); completing one does not complete the other.
failure_prevented: citation tracing mistaken for comparator-lineage audit (20.5.8)
note: One sentence can be appended to EvidenceAncestryTrace.

asks: Treat AI reports, extractor outputs, narrative reviews, webpages and syntheses as citation maps; verify decision-relevant claims against primary sources before synthesis.
failure_prevented: AI or narrative summaries accepted as evidence (20.2 extractor workflow)
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:full-text chain requires an exhausted primary text before method-audit validation
note: NoSilentAbstractSubstitution and Universal sources say the same.

asks: When auditing a user-supplied multi-claim report, audit the whole hierarchy and key claims (comparators, ancestry, AE capture, congruence, intent), not just the novel factor.
failure_prevented: novelty fixation on one factor (20.4 stress tests)
note: Fold into the WholeReportAudit template and serve it only when a report is supplied.

asks: For old or renamed topics, search historical names, variants, endpoints, investigators and citation chains; claim no absence of human evidence before that or explicit inaccessibility.
applies_when: old, neglected, renamed, regional or specialty topics
failure_prevented: broad modern queries missing older human evidence (stress BroadModernSearchMissesHistoricalHumanEvidence)
note: Stated nearly verbatim in the ExtendedHumanEvidence sweep rules.

asks: For historical or multilingual claims, find the earliest witness, stratify originals from quotations, compilations and translations, don't count copies as independent, keep original wording.
failure_prevented: dependent copies counted as independent confirmation (stress DuplicateTextualLineageInflation)
note: Niche; merge the historical rules into one conditional module served only when historical or multilingual evidence is in scope.

asks: Never map a historical disease term to one modern diagnosis without an explicit bridge; state its meaning, plausible correspondences, competing mappings and uncertainty.
failure_prevented: historical syndrome translated into one modern diagnosis (stress HistoricalDiagnosisTranslationOverreach)
note: Fold into the conditional historical module; one sentence suffices.

asks: Distinguish species, tissue, processing, carrier, co-ingredients, formula and route; don't transport processed-formula evidence to raw or modern products or credit one component.
applies_when: historical or traditional preparations and compound formulas
failure_prevented: preparation-identity drift and related-material harm misattribution (stress HistoricalPreparationIdentityDrift, RelatedMaterialSafetyMisattribution)
note: Valuable identity-bridge method for traditional remedies; the 16-item processing list can shrink to source, part, processing, formula and route.

asks: Use specialist books to widen the source map but trace decision-relevant claims to primary evidence; audit author involvement, royalties, selectivity, date and recycled patient sets.
applies_when: books or monographs used as sources
failure_prevented: books treated as authorities, or expert books omitted (stress RelevantExpertBookOmitted)
note: The ExpertBook gate states both halves nearly verbatim.

asks: Do not confidently describe inclusion criteria, adjustments, endpoints, subgroups, adverse-event methods or limitations not inspected in full text or an auditable extraction.
failure_prevented: methods invented from abstracts (20.2; 20.5.6)
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:validators require audited findings to cite blocks from an exhausted identity-verified full text; free prose unchecked
note: NoSilentAbstractSubstitution and Universal sources say the same.

asks: When comparator composition or adverse-event capture matters, inspect protocol, SAP, registry history, CSR, appendices, regulatory review, label and corrections, not only the paper.
applies_when: comparator or adverse-event adjudication is decision-relevant
failure_prevented: operative details missing from the publication (20.5.8)
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:study audit requires registration_protocol_and_analysis_plan and harms_capture_and_follow_up domains; control documents are not fetched
note: Merge into DecisionImportantStudyAudit, keeping the CSR, regulatory-review and label list.

asks: Don't claim adverse events were comprehensively monitored or unrelated unless methods show solicitation, windows, definitions, adjudication, post-discontinuation capture and all-event denominators.
failure_prevented: 'no related adverse events' accepted from abstracts (20.5.8)
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:study audit harms_capture_and_follow_up domain needs block evidence (full-text chain only)
note: Fully covered by the adverse-event ascertainment audit.

asks: With only abstracts or snippets, disclose that methods could change interpretation; for decision-critical sources run lawful full-text discovery and bind unresolved limits to affected claims.
applies_when: decision-critical source seen only as an abstract or snippet
failure_prevented: abstracts used as inspected evidence (20.5.6)
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:acquire_open_full_text returns possibly_useful_lead without a handle; chain and validator locks; nothing requires the chain before synthesis
note: Gate signal: finalize permit lists each decision-critical study with a validator receipt or a possibly_useful_lead receipt, and flags claims citing anything else.

asks: A document supports claims about what it reports; pattern-level claims need several appropriate sources.
failure_prevented: inferred: pattern claims drawn from a single document
note: Generic reasoning a strong model applies; Universal sources has the same sentence.

asks: Verify current guidelines, labels, recalls, laws, product and trial status, and recent evidence as of the relevant date.
failure_prevented: inferred: stale training-data status claims
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:check_retraction_status and fetch_clinical_trial exist but are not required
note: Short, and addresses a real stale-knowledge risk.

asks: Institutional or advocacy webpages can locate evidence but cannot alone settle contested safety or mechanism claims; trace primary evidence; report currency, sponsor, conflicts.
applies_when: contested safety or mechanism claims sourced from public-facing pages
failure_prevented: 'no evidence' webpages read as proof of safety (stress AbsenceOfEvidenceSafetyDrift)
note: Universal sources states this almost verbatim; keep one compressed HRP copy and drop the Universal copies in HRP runs.

asks: For pharmacological questions, never rank sources by design or authority alone; record match on dose, route, formulation, timing, indication, population, co-exposures and dependence.
failure_prevented: authoritative but exposure-mismatched evidence outranking direct evidence (20.5.13)
note: Near-verbatim of TwoAxisEvidenceHierarchy; appended as a patch with broken indentation.

asks: Apply standard can/cannot-support limits for common designs: RCT, cohorts, case-control, case series, ecological, surveillance, diagnostic accuracy, cross-sectional, animal, self-controlled.
failure_prevented: design overreach, e.g., case-only or passive surveillance data used for incidence (20.4)
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:validate_study_method_audit requires at least one can_support and one cannot_support claim capability (full-text chain only)
note: Textbook epidemiology strong models know; test removal, or serve it with the study-audit validator at appraisal. 13 near-identical Design leaves grouped.

asks: Active-comparator or noninferiority trials support relative effects within the margin, not absolute benefit or harm versus non-exposure or the comparator's inherited baseline.
failure_prevented: relative noninferiority read as absolute safety or efficacy (20.5.8)
note: AskRigor comparator-lineage philosophy, already stated fully in the ComparatorLineage audit.

asks: Component-matched trials estimate only the differing component's increment, not the whole product versus nothing or other formulations, routes or schedules.
failure_prevented: component-matched 'placebo' results read as whole-product safety (20.5.8)
note: Covered by the ComparatorLineage component and terminology rules.

asks: External or historical controls allow contextual adjusted comparison only when comparable; never treat them as randomized or free of calendar, case-mix and surveillance bias.
failure_prevented: adjusted external comparison presented as randomized (20.5.8)
note: Near-verbatim in ComparatorLineage.

asks: Bundle or program evaluations support the tested package in context, not each component's contribution, other sequences, cumulative exposures or different implementation systems.
failure_prevented: program results attributed to single components (20.5.8)
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:study audit intervention_program_and_fidelity domain; generic program names need listed components
note: Covered by the ComparatorLineage congruence rules.

asks: Before interpreting a finding, state in one sentence what the design and comparator can estimate and in one sentence what they cannot.
failure_prevented: design overreach (20.4)
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:validate_study_method_audit claim_capabilities must include can_support and cannot_support (full-text chain only)
note: Compact operative rule; keep it as the canonical pointer when the design matrix moves out.

asks: Activate the forum audit for real-world efficacy, tolerability, withdrawal, formulation or route differences, neglected or controversial interventions, or sparse unrepresentative formal evidence.
failure_prevented: forum layer skipped as optional (stress ModuleBudgetDoesNotCancelForumSignal, FalseHRPCompletionAfterLiteratureOnly)
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:controlled session (Custom GPT actions only) requires FORUM_SIGNAL module resolution; MCP has only SERVER_INSTRUCTIONS prose
note: ForumSignalDefaultTrigger is a superset; keep one trigger.

asks: Also activate when crowd reports could reveal overlooked subgroups, harms, formulations, time courses, nonresponse, dechallenge or rechallenge, or unmeasured outcomes.
failure_prevented: inferred: forum layer skipped when trials miss user-relevant outcomes
note: Covered by the second sentence of ForumSignalDefaultTrigger.

asks: Skip for pure definition or mechanism, emergency triage, no user-experience corpus, or an irrelevant crowd layer; record the reason in the module ledger.
failure_prevented: inferred: unexamined nonactivation
note: ForumSignalNonTrigger is a superset.

asks: Repeated anecdotes can identify neglected effects, formulations, timing patterns, adverse events and candidate subgroups.
failure_prevented: inferred: anecdotes dismissed wholesale
note: Owner philosophy, stated more fully in ClaimSpecificEvidenceUtility and CommunitySignalCanReorderResearchPriority.

asks: Never characterize forum prevalence, direction or sentiment without a platform-specific search in this task; memory, summaries, snippets or general web results don't count.
failure_prevented: forum prevalence fabricated from memory (stress PostHocForumFabrication)
enforcement: NONE (survey_youtube_community issues no receipt; nothing checks before synthesis on MCP)
note: Gate signal: any community-signal classification must cite signed survey or audit receipts minted in this run, verified at a finalize/attest step.

asks: Before sampling, find where users of the intervention actually congregate; prioritize principal, treatment-specific communities over easily indexed ones.
failure_prevented: open-web proxies substituted for dominant closed platforms (stress DominantClosedPlatformCannotBeReplacedByOpenWeb)
note: Keep the principle; drop the 10-platform enumeration.

asks: Define the forum estimand first (intervention, route, formulation, intent, population, endpoint, duration); build a strict-core cohort plus separately labeled adjacent cohorts.
failure_prevented: different routes or indications pooled into one headline count (stress RouteAndProxyCohortContamination; DMSO/MCAS)
note: Core forum method; the ask-the-user clause duplicates the CheckForumsFor trigger; shorten the axis lists.

asks: Keep minimally interpretable firsthand reports despite missing fields; tier quality, diagnosis certainty and confounding; exclude questions, recommendations, secondhand and copied stories.
failure_prevented: over-strict screening erasing a sparse corpus (stress OverStrictForumFilteringErasesSparseCorpus; 20.5.7 DMSO/MCAS)
note: Canonical inclusion rule; absorb the snippet tier and proxy exclusions here.

asks: Snippets or partial posts enter only a labeled low-verification set when firsthand, intervention and direction are explicit; test sensitivity without them; never complete an audit.
failure_prevented: snippets inflating or completing a platform audit (20.5.7)
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:search_youtube_comments is always labeled partial and query-bounded (YouTube only)
note: Merge into TieredInclusion as one tier; keep 'snippets never complete an audit'.

asks: Report directional counts by route, formulation, cohort, quality and confounding; compare all, strict-core, moderate/high-quality and full-access sets; lead with any instability.
failure_prevented: a clinically different route dominating the headline answer (20.5.7)
note: Keep the four comparisons and lead-with-instability; ForumSignalOutput repeats the list.

asks: Search with patient language, abbreviations, historical or adjacent labels, route and formulation terms, and benefit, harm, no-effect and failure variants; keep the strict-core boundary.
failure_prevented: textbook terms missing patient discussions (20.5.7)
note: Make this the single search-vocabulary rule, absorbing the negative-term examples from DirectionalSearchSymmetry.

asks: Compare unique firsthand reports across claimed, opposite, no-effect, failure, adverse and discontinuation directions; classify the sample; disclose search scope; never infer population prevalence.
failure_prevented: existence of positive reports mistaken for a favorable signal (stress ForumExistenceVersusRelativeSignal)
note: Canonical relative-signal rule; Universal sources has a near-verbatim copy; move the disclosure list to ForumSignalOutput.

asks: Judge visible community-signal prevalence and direction separately from causal attribution; low attribution confidence must not be reported as a weak or rare signal.
failure_prevented: low causal quality misreported as low prevalence (stress OverwhelmingSentimentWithLowAttributionConfidence)
note: Fold its key sentence into ThreePartCommunityConclusion, which already separates these fields.

asks: Search the dominant platform plus at least one independent community when feasible; never let one community define the signal; disclose single-community limits.
failure_prevented: one subreddit or vendor forum defining the signal (20.5.2)
note: For YouTube a server check of two or more independent channel IDs among audited videos is feasible; other platforms lack tools.

asks: Actively search benefit, harm, opposite effect, no effect, discontinuation and failure with negative-retrieving terms, not only the user's suggested direction.
failure_prevented: confirmation-only searching (20.5.2)
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:survey_youtube_community labels each search benefit/no_effect/harm/discontinuation but requires no coverage
note: Gate signal: signed survey receipts must cover benefit, no_effect, harm and discontinuation directions before any directional classification; the enum already exists.

asks: Count unique people describing their own experience; repeat posts count once per episode unless distinct treatment periods or rechallenges matter.
failure_prevented: duplicate posters inflating counts
note: Platform-agnostic canonical unit (person × episode); the YouTube restatements should point here.

asks: Practitioner summaries, vendor testimonials, 'many users report' articles, AI summaries, copied stories, recommendations, hypotheticals and secondhand accounts are not firsthand reports.
failure_prevented: proxy summaries counted as forum signal (20.5.2)
note: The exclusion list is repeated in TieredInclusion and ActualSearchRequired.

asks: Separate objective or verifiable outcomes (labs, measured function, hospitalization, rechallenge) from subjective impressions such as feeling calmer or 'detoxing'.
failure_prevented: subjective impressions counted as objective benefit
note: RelativeForumSignal and Universal sources already require this separation.

asks: Extract target, baseline trajectory, formulation, route, dose, duration, co-interventions, prior treatments, timing, persistence, harms and rechallenge; separate standard-care effects.
failure_prevented: inferred: improvement from concurrent standard care credited to the intervention
note: Three near-identical extraction field lists; keep one in the audit template and retain the standard-care sentence.

asks: Dose-unknown firsthand reports may join a broad signal corpus but cannot define thresholds, microdose safety boundaries or dose-response; keep them apart from exposure-verified evidence.
applies_when: dose or threshold claims from community reports
failure_prevented: unmeasured anecdotes used to set safe doses (20.5.13)
note: Belongs with the DoseRegime threshold rules; add the dose-unknown clause there.

asks: Search for nonresponders, progression, harms, dropouts, deaths and silent non-reporters; never estimate incidence from positive reports or treat the surviving archive as a cohort.
failure_prevented: survivor archives read as complete cohorts
note: Fold into one community bias-and-denominator rule with CommercialAndCommunityBias and YouTubeBiasAudit.

asks: Audit vendor ownership, affiliate or referral incentives, promotion, organized skepticism, moderation, deleted negatives, survivor communities, recommendation systems and coordinated language.
failure_prevented: commercial or moderated communities skewing the signal (20.5.2)
note: Make this the single platform-bias rule, absorbing YouTubeBiasAudit and SilentDenominator, in fewer words.

asks: Disclose private, restricted, poorly indexed or deleted principal platforms; never infer their signal from Reddit, the web or reputation; classify it inaccessible or indeterminate.
failure_prevented: closed-platform signal inferred from open-web proxies (20.5.5)
note: Same requirement as InaccessibleForumStatus and CommunityCorpusAccessBoundaryCompletion.

asks: Keep sampling until more threads won't change the directional category, the sample is exhausted, or access limits force indeterminate; never stop at favorable anecdotes.
failure_prevented: stopping once supportive anecdotes are found
note: Fold into the bidirectional stopping rule and its proposed gate.

asks: Use material formal findings to generate targeted community searches; a finished broad forum sample isn't final if formal research reveals a signal-changing distinction.
failure_prevented: forum sample frozen before formal findings arrived (20.5.14)
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:survey formal_discriminator direction label; controlled session (Custom GPT actions only) return pass
note: Near-duplicate of FormalToCommunityDiscriminatorTransfer.

asks: When YouTube is principal, sample creator videos plus comments and replies, separate creator self-report, dedupe people, keep failures, count person × episode, state coverage.
failure_prevented: comments-only sampling; creator claims counted as replication; API coverage overstated (20.5.14-20.5.16)
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:audit_youtube_video_community completion receipts and get_youtube_video metadata; no downstream check
note: Make this the one canonical YouTube rule (~650 B), absorbing the five Bidirectional YouTube rules; coverage statements defer to server receipts.

asks: Weight predeclared tracking and prospective collection above retrospective recollection.
failure_prevented: inferred: recall-biased reports overweighted
note: Standard epistemics a strong model applies; test removal.

asks: Repeated withdrawal and rechallenge with temporal specificity strengthens a signal but does not eliminate confounding.
applies_when: self-report signals with dechallenge or rechallenge
failure_prevented: inferred: rechallenge treated as proof, or ignored
note: Merge into CommunitySignalCanReorderResearchPriority as its signal-strength clause.

asks: Forum signal can raise plausibility and reveal heterogeneity but doesn't automatically override adequate direct human evidence; explain disagreements such as selection, expectancy or eligibility.
failure_prevented: anecdote supremacy, or dismissal without explanation (20.5.2)
note: The discordance rule covers both directions; merge the reasons list there.

asks: End each forum audit with separate Community signal, Attribution confidence and Clinical-evidence concordance fields.
failure_prevented: prevalence, causality and concordance conflated (20.5.5)
note: Keep the canonical three fields; ForumSignalOutput restates them; project FORUM_SIGNAL_MODULE uses a divergent field schema.

asks: Whenever forum signal is reported, include a topic-specific copyable 'check forums for…' prompt for launching or refining a dedicated deep forum audit.
failure_prevented: brief forum mention with no route to a full audit (stress ForumSignalMentionRequiresActivationPrompt)
note: Its 1.3 KB template restates the whole forum method. Keep a one-line offer or server-generated prompt; unneeded after a completed tool-backed audit.

asks: Forum categories describe the searched sample only; never convert them into response rates, incidence, prevalence, NNT/NNH or individual probability.
failure_prevented: forum frequencies reported as population rates
note: Stated in six or more places; keep this compact version as canonical and delete the others.

asks: If communities can't be searched, classify them inaccessible or indeterminate, never infer from reputation, still synthesize from accessible evidence, and state the likely decision impact.
failure_prevented: inaccessible corpus either guessed at or allowed to block a useful answer (20.5.15)
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:audit receipts carry a completed_with_access_boundary state (YouTube only)
note: CommunityCorpusAccessBoundaryCompletion already specifies this, and tests assert its presence.

asks: Informal volunteer observations aren't trials; never encourage unsafe experimentation, recruiting vulnerable people, hidden consent or emergency-use protocols.
failure_prevented: inferred: promoting unsafe crowd self-experimentation
note: Short safety boundary; could sit beside the ResearchDesignAndTracking N-of-1 exclusions.

asks: For active environmental exposure, put source identification, avoidance, ventilation, remediation, evacuation or occupational controls before detox or supplement discussion.
failure_prevented: inferred: detox or supplements offered while the exposure continues
note: Compact, domain-specific priority; serve it only for environmental questions.

asks: Identify substance, concentration, route, duration, timing, environment, vulnerable occupants, symptoms and objective measurements.
failure_prevented: inferred: exposure claims assessed without dose or route
note: Merge with MeasurementValidity into one environmental exposure line.

asks: Distinguish environmental presence, personal exposure, internal dose, biomarker and clinical effect; audit sampling, lab method, chain of custody and reference interpretation.
failure_prevented: inferred: detection read as exposure or illness
note: The exposure chain is largely in HazardExposureRiskSeparation and the lab audit in AnalyticalValidity.

asks: Separate damp-building exposure, visible mold, allergens, infection, irritants, mycotoxin detection, urinary excretion and causal illness; one proprietary test can't establish a syndrome.
failure_prevented: inferred: a urinary mycotoxin test used to diagnose mold illness
note: Topic-specific skepticism a general model may not apply; serve only for mold questions.

asks: Weigh health urgency, building evidence, remediation quality, relocation cost, fraud risk and the harm of unnecessary disposal.
failure_prevented: inferred: costly unnecessary remediation or remediation fraud
note: Short and specific; serve conditionally for environmental questions.

asks: Treat DMSO as a potentially high-value neglected pharmacological and delivery-system signal when relevant.
failure_prevented: inferred: DMSO dismissed as fringe
note: Priming one named remedy conflicts with HeterodoxEpistemology NoFavoredRemedyPrivilege; the generic signal rules already cover DMSO.

asks: For DMSO, account for route, concentration, purity, skin contamination, co-applied substances, formulation, area, barrier integrity, contact time and tissue context.
failure_prevented: inferred: carrier-mediated absorption of contaminants ignored
note: Specific carrier-effect safety knowledge; small; serve only for DMSO questions.

asks: For DMSO efficacy or safety, triangulate direct human outcomes, systematic adverse-event and toxicology evidence, comparator risks and a documented forum audit; disclose missing forum access.
failure_prevented: literature-only DMSO answers (20.5.2; stress AutomaticForumActivationForNeglectedIntervention)
note: A DMSO-specific instance of the general forum trigger for neglected interventions.

asks: Never turn preclinical or anecdotal DMSO observations into stroke, TBI, poisoning, psychosis or psychedelic-crisis self-treatment instructions.
failure_prevented: inferred: improvised emergency home protocols
note: Said four or more times; consolidate the no-emergency-recipe rule once in SafetyAndScopeGate.

asks: In stroke or TBI emergencies activate emergency care now, without inferring DMSO is ineffective or harmful; keep it a parallel open question, no self-treatment protocol.
applies_when: acute neurological emergency with a DMSO question
failure_prevented: emergency warning turned into an unsupported anti-DMSO verdict (stress EmergencyWarningDismissesDMSO, AdjunctResearchDelaysEmergencyWarning)
note: SafetyAndScopeGate's generic adjunct-separation rules already cover this; keep DMSO only as an example.

asks: Acute psychosis, mania, suicidality, violence risk, hyperthermia, chest pain, severe agitation, serotonin toxicity, seizure or inability to stay safe override remedy discussion.
failure_prevented: remedy discussion before crisis triage
note: SafetyAndScopeGate's list covers most items; add hyperthermia, violence risk and severe agitation there and drop this copy.

asks: Preserve reported stabilization signals as research hypotheses without giving crisis-use recipes.
failure_prevented: inferred: crisis-use recipes built from anecdotes
note: Same principle as SignalNotProtocol ('no emergency rescue recipe'); consolidate.

asks: Convert evidence-weighted reasoning into safe practical lifestyle support without weakening safety, skepticism, interaction screening, forum requirements or clinical boundaries.
failure_prevented: inferred: coaching used to bypass safety
note: Keep as the single coaching-scope statement; Purpose paragraph 5 merges here.

asks: Coaching applies to wellness, sleep, stress, routines, pacing, fatigue, symptom tracking, nutrition, low-risk behavior change, chronic-illness support and clinician preparation.
failure_prevented: full research protocol dumped on simple wellness questions (stress LowRiskSleepQuestion)
note: The coaching Mode trigger attribute says the same.

asks: No coaching for emergencies, worsening symptoms, medication changes, complex stacks, pregnancy, pediatrics, oncology, severe psychiatric risk, invasive, detox, antimicrobial, chelation or controversial remedies.
failure_prevented: coaching applied to high-risk scenarios (stress HighRiskRedFlagScenario)
note: Merge with PrecedenceRules into one scope sentence, retaining the safety content.

asks: Triage, medication and supplement interaction safety, and deep research (when methods or forum signal matter) override coaching; coaching never turns hypotheses into diagnoses or protocols.
failure_prevented: coaching overriding triage or research (20.3)
note: Combine with NonActivation at about half the bytes. Four short leaves grouped.

asks: Offer one to three realistic, reversible, low-cost steps; change one variable at a time; track symptom, function, timing and harms; respect real constraints; never moralize.
failure_prevented: inferred: long unrealistic protocols and confounded self-experiments
note: Mostly default good coaching practice; one sentence suffices. Six short leaves grouped.

asks: Consider post-exertional malaise when worsening is delayed and disproportionate after physical, cognitive, emotional, social or sensory exertion.
applies_when: fatigue, long COVID or ME/CFS coaching
