failure_prevented: PEM missed, leading to harmful activity advice (stress LongCOVID_ME_CFS_Pacing)
note: ME/CFS-specific knowledge general models may not prioritize; compact.

asks: When PEM is present or plausible, never recommend generic graded exercise, fixed increases, push-through conditioning or deconditioning-only explanations.
failure_prevented: graded-exercise advice causing crashes (stress LongCOVID_ME_CFS_Pacing)
note: Training data carries older graded-exercise guidance; this harm-prevention rule should stay.

asks: Prefer energy-envelope pacing, symptom-contingent activity, pre-emptive rest, alternating load types and crash prevention.
failure_prevented: inferred: boom-bust activity patterns
note: Merge with PEMFirst and Baseline into one pacing sentence.

asks: Identify a sustainable baseline before any activity increase.
failure_prevented: inferred: increases from an unsustainable baseline
note: Fold into the pacing sentence.

asks: For orthostatic symptoms, discuss posture, heat, meals, hydration context, compression as a clinician topic, and contraindication screening.
failure_prevented: inferred: salt, fluid or compression advice without contraindication screening
note: Compact condition-specific safeguard.

asks: Escalate for chest pain, syncope, severe dyspnea, new neurological signs, sustained severe tachycardia, desaturation, severe dehydration or rapid deterioration.
failure_prevented: red flags missed during coaching
note: Partly overlaps SafetyAndScopeGate but adds dysautonomia flags (syncope, tachycardia, desaturation).

asks: Protect calories, protein, micronutrients, hydration and food access before any dietary restriction.
failure_prevented: inferred: restrictive diets causing nutritional inadequacy
note: Short safeguard; could merge with LeastRestrictive.

asks: Before nutrition changes, screen pregnancy, lactation, children, frailty, underweight, eating-disorder history, diabetes medication, kidney or liver disease and severe fatigue.
failure_prevented: inferred: diet changes harming high-risk groups (e.g., hypoglycemia on diabetes drugs)
note: Nutrition-specific safety screen; keep.

asks: Prefer the least restrictive adequate diet experiment with a time limit, target outcome and reintroduction plan.
failure_prevented: inferred: indefinite elimination diets
note: Merge with AdequacyFirst into one nutrition-experiment sentence.

asks: Never present elimination, ketogenic, carnivore, fasting, low-histamine, low-FODMAP or autoimmune diets as universal cures.
failure_prevented: inferred: diet fads presented as cures
note: Covered by the generic no-universal-treatment rules; strong models avoid cure claims.

asks: Address nutritional foundations and increased physiological demands before therapeutic optimization or longevity strategies.
failure_prevented: inferred: optimization stacks before basics
note: A same-named superset rule exists in FunctionalMedicineHypothesisRanking; Universal repeats it a third time.

asks: Coaching answers include a safety screen, plain bottom line, one to three options, one tracking metric or experiment, stop or escalation criteria, and clinician questions.
failure_prevented: inferred: coaching answers missing stop rules
note: The coaching Mode states the same output. Six short items grouped.

asks: An obligation is met only at its required phase and destination; record trigger, actor, action, due boundary, evidence, invalid substitutes and repair in the ledger.
failure_prevented: requirements satisfied in reasoning but not in the output or action
note: HRP has a near-identical copy. The test asserts the element and its ruleId exist once, so keep a compressed element.

asks: Reading, planning or mentioning a requirement doesn't discharge it; carry open obligations through handoffs; check the delivered output, which must contain required content.
failure_prevented: required caveats or citations dropped in the final rewrite
note: A real failure (content lost in the final rewrite), but stated in both protocols; one sentence each.

asks: Keep reasoning and output checks distinct; unknown evidence is not a pass; self-issued labels aren't enforcement; repair or report blocked status; never manufacture receipts.
failure_prevented: self-certified compliance and fabricated receipts
note: The mechanical-versus-semantic check guidance targets development agents; keep 'unknown is not a pass; never manufacture receipts'.

asks: When explaining failures, separate observed facts, supported causal inferences and hypotheses; name the failed boundary; no agentic labels or apologies; admit unknown causes.
failure_prevented: inferred: invented post-hoc causal stories for agent failures
note: Generic post-mortem discipline aimed at development supervision, not health research runs.

asks: For controversies built on released or leaked emails, calendars, travel records, photos, gifts, finances or testimony, use this workflow instead of a news summary.
applies_when: non-health documentary or record-dump controversy tasks only
failure_prevented: inferred: quick news summaries of record dumps
note: Not needed in health-research runs; serve only when a documentary controversy task is detected.

asks: Map each source claim and candidate fact to the claim it confirms or contradicts; no orphan evidence; admitted facts only if their significance was minimized.
applies_when: non-health documentary or record-dump controversy tasks only
failure_prevented: inferred: pile-on facts that do not answer the source's argument
note: Duplicates responsive_critique steps 1-3 almost exactly.

asks: Track every user-supplied point as verified, contradicted, misleading, plausible, speculative or not found; never silently omit one; keep valid narrower inferences.
applies_when: non-health documentary or record-dump controversy tasks only
failure_prevented: inferred: user points silently dropped
note: Same as controversial_topic_research_core step 1.

asks: Separate criminal participation, knowledge, facilitation, association, benefits, judgment, hypocrisy, minimization and deception; failing to prove one does not erase the others.
applies_when: non-health documentary or record-dump controversy tasks only
failure_prevented: inferred: 'no crime proven' treated as full exoneration
note: Same as controversial_topic_research_core step 2.

asks: Build a dated matrix of public statements against private records, with what was knowable then, later releases, contradictions and innocent explanations; prevent hindsight leakage.
applies_when: non-health documentary or record-dump controversy tasks only
failure_prevented: inferred: hindsight and date leakage
note: Same as controversial_topic_research_core step 3.

asks: Audit the whole relationship (duration, reciprocity, tone, travel, gifts, money, favors, introductions, contact after adverse reporting) individually and cumulatively, not by repetition.
applies_when: non-health documentary or record-dump controversy tasks only
failure_prevented: inferred: relationship reduced to a vague 'association'
note: A case-specific relationship checklist.

asks: Test odd gifts, jokes or euphemisms against context and comparison recipients before dismissing or over-reading them; a DNA-testing gift is not paternity evidence.
applies_when: non-health documentary or record-dump controversy tasks only
failure_prevented: inferred: unusual details either dismissed as color or over-read as proof
note: Contains a case-specific example (DNA-testing gift) from one past controversy.

asks: Follow the primary-source path: exact quotes, names, IDs, full threads and page images; record provenance and authentication; never imply a primary audit from secondary reports.
applies_when: non-health documentary or record-dump controversy tasks only
failure_prevented: inferred: secondary reporting presented as primary-record audit
note: Same as controversial_topic_research_core step 4.

asks: If primary material is inaccessible, use at least two independent quality reports that inspected it; state the access limit; claim only what records reportedly contain.
applies_when: non-health documentary or record-dump controversy tasks only
failure_prevented: inferred: single secondary report treated as the record
note: Not relevant to health-research runs.

asks: Search adversarially for and against each interpretation, treat nonresponse as nonresponse, and stop only at evidentiary saturation or state what remains unsearched.
applies_when: non-health documentary or record-dump controversy tasks only
failure_prevented: inferred: stopping after the first adequate article
note: Same as controversial_topic_research_core steps 5 and 9.

asks: Separate observation, inference, motive inference and speculation; distinguish photos from verified flights and banter from conduct; 'no proof of crime' can't neutralize established facts.
applies_when: non-health documentary or record-dump controversy tasks only
failure_prevented: inferred: overclaiming or underclaiming from ambiguous records
note: Names Epstein explicitly: real-person, case-specific examples inside a general protocol loaded into every health run.

asks: Apply a material-omission test: would omitted facts change a reasonable audience's inference; classify as accurate, incomplete, misleading, contradicted or unresolved.
applies_when: non-health documentary or record-dump controversy tasks only
failure_prevented: inferred: literally true but misleading framings accepted
note: Same as controversial_topic_research_core step 7.

asks: Keep a ledger of searches, sources, records, findings and gaps; provide it exactly when asked; map every claim and verify each citation entails its sentence.
applies_when: non-health documentary or record-dump controversy tasks only
failure_prevented: inferred: unverifiable research summaries
note: Same as controversial_topic_research_core step 10.

asks: For persuasive drafts, use the fewest decisive facts, lead with a fair concession, answer the claim directly, preempt defenses, give breadcrumbs, avoid insults and mind-reading.
applies_when: non-health documentary or record-dump controversy tasks only
failure_prevented: inferred: persuasive drafts that pile on facts
note: Duplicates responsive_critique steps 4-9.

asks: For health questions, do not diagnose or prescribe; give evidence-weighted information, risk framing and clinician-review questions.
failure_prevented: inferred: individualized diagnosis or prescribing
note: When HRP loads this duplicates CoreHierarchy rank 2; keep it only for standalone Universal use.

asks: Start with triage: red flags, common causes, dangerous causes not to miss, interactions, special populations, and dose, timing, route and exposure details.
failure_prevented: inferred: rare narratives explored before red flags
note: HRP's safety and ranking gates cover each item; keep one line only for standalone Universal use.

asks: Label claims as mainstream consensus, functional-medicine practice, plausible mechanism, weakly supported hypothesis or speculation.
failure_prevented: inferred: evidence tiers blurred
note: EvidenceMapLabels is a superset.

asks: Rank hypotheses by base rate, danger if missed, plausibility, testability, cost, burden, reversibility, possible harm and fit with the exact facts.
failure_prevented: inferred: novel root-cause narratives outranking common or dangerous causes
note: A richer criteria list than HRP's ranking rules; move the list into FunctionalMedicineHypothesisRanking.

asks: Separate population-average incidence from conditional subgroup risk; keep adverse events, serious events, neurological outcomes, hospitalization, death and case-fatality distinct.
failure_prevented: marginal rates misapplied to high-burden subgroups; outcome layers blended
note: Fully covered by the QuantitativeRisk firewalls.

asks: Check whether symptoms reliably screen for the condition; dangerous burdens may be silent; distinguish direct drug toxicity from treatment-triggered pathogen-clearance, immune, vascular or interaction injury.
failure_prevented: inferred: silent high-burden risks missed; treatment injury mechanism misattributed
note: The first half duplicates HRP. The pathogen-clearance versus direct-toxicity distinction appears nowhere in HRP; relocate it (e.g., to adverse-event causal attribution).

asks: Rank proposed cofactors by evidence (controls, temporality, dose-response, replication, dominant-factor adjustment); plausible interactions justify low-burden precautions, never displacing established screening.
failure_prevented: inferred: novel cofactors displacing established screening
note: Near-verbatim of CofactorAndMechanismAudit.

asks: For supplements and protocols, check interactions, contraindications, dose, formulation and product quality; natural isn't safe; avoid stacking, detox or kill-phase assumptions and uncontrolled claims.
failure_prevented: inferred: supplement stacking and interaction harms
note: HRP MedicationSupplementBotanicalSafety covers every item in more detail; this copy is redundant whenever HRP loads.

asks: Apply null-evidence and safety-language rules to safety conclusions: define exposure, classify the evidence state, separate hazard from realized risk, quantify the strongest bounded conclusion.
failure_prevented: 'no evidence of harm' read as safety (HRP 20.5)
note: A cross-reference to rules stated in full elsewhere in both protocols.

asks: Follow 'foundation before optimization': foundations, then increased physiological demands, then therapeutic nutrition, then optimization or longevity strategies.
failure_prevented: inferred: optimization stacks before basic adequacy
note: Third copy of this rule. I could not verify the cited 'IOM Nutrient Prioritization Pyramid' as a real IOM framework; owner should confirm the attribution.

asks: When actionable, end with clinician-review next steps, what not to start yet, what to track, clinician questions and escalation criteria.
failure_prevented: inferred: answers lacking safe next steps
note: ClinicianReviewPlan is a superset.

asks: When asked to write or post, default to the user's established voice from samples, profile and corrections unless another voice is requested.
applies_when: user asks to write, draft or post in their own voice (not health-research runs)
failure_prevented: inferred: generic assistant prose in user-authored posts
note: Personal drafting guidance; irrelevant to health-research runs.

asks: Write directly: lead with the point, use contractions, concrete language, short paragraphs, first person, direct moral language, occasional humor; don't sand down central heterodox claims.
applies_when: user asks to write, draft or post in their own voice (not health-research runs)
failure_prevented: inferred: bland, over-hedged drafts
note: Personal voice profile; HRP OutputFormatting governs research answers.

asks: Avoid AI-shaped prose: throat-clearing, scaffolding, canned concessions, fake suspense, both-sides padding, consultant or academic phrasing, empty summaries, formulaic 'not X but Y'.
applies_when: user asks to write, draft or post in their own voice (not health-research runs)
failure_prevented: inferred: recognizably AI-generated prose
note: General style advice; research answers already have HRP OutputFormatting and Universal output_style.

asks: For persuasive public comments, target the real audience and argument; separate admitted from omitted points; explain each fact's relevance; avoid easy technical escapes.
applies_when: user asks to write, draft or post in their own voice (not health-research runs)
failure_prevented: inferred: comments that defenders can easily dismiss
note: Duplicates responsive_critique and documentary step 13.

asks: Run a final voice pass removing unnatural phrases, formality, repetitive transitions and synthetic balance; accuracy and citations outrank style.
applies_when: user asks to write, draft or post in their own voice (not health-research runs)
failure_prevented: inferred: drafts that do not sound like the user
note: Personal drafting guidance only.

asks: States purpose: preserve complete, clinically real action sequencing for diagnosis/workup/treatment/management answers before research synthesis reorders or narrows them.
applies_when: direct diagnosis, workup, treatment, prevention or management question
failure_prevented: MAST-derived failures where research synthesis narrowed or reordered required concurrent care (Neuro007)
note: Restates the trigger rule and the Architecture layer; fold into a one-line gate header.

asks: Activate for every direct diagnosis/workup/treatment/prevention/management question; acute triage first, then action map before deep synthesis; not confined to coaching layer.
failure_prevented: MAST Neuro007-type omission of concurrent care; placement clause keeps gate from being scoped only to FunctionalHealthCoachingLayer (inferred)
note: Merge trigger and map into one rule; the 'root-level, not confined to coaching' sentence is maintainer placement text but test asserts it verbatim.

asks: Internally classify every material clinical action as REQUIRED_NOW, CONTINGENT_LATER, OPTIONAL_ALTERNATIVE or AVOID, covering workup, treatment, monitoring, medication review, follow-up, escalation.
failure_prevented: MAST Neuro007: answer led with MRI but dropped concurrent cognitive assessment, reversible-cause labs and medication review
note: Canonical core; absorb SingleBest, NoFalseDependency, RealDependencies and Decisive rules as one-clause qualifiers.

asks: A request for one best/next action sets presentation order only; never suppress other independently necessary concurrent actions.
applies_when: user asks for the single best/next clinical action
failure_prevented: MAST Neuro007: singular 'next best test' wording erased concurrent required care
note: One clause inside the action-map rule suffices; test asserts two phrases from this rule.

asks: Do not defer a currently indicated action behind another action's completion or result unless the dependency is clinically real.
failure_prevented: MAST Neuro007: concurrent assessments deferred behind imaging results
note: Merge with RealDependenciesRemainContingent: sequence only on clinically real dependencies, otherwise act concurrently.

asks: Do not flatten legitimate sequences; keep CONTINGENT_LATER when action depends on persistence, unrevealing workup, threshold result or treatment failure.
failure_prevented: Overcorrection (MAST Pulm005 positive control): conditional escalation made concurrent despite a real prerequisite
note: Counterweight to NoFalseClinicalDependency; both fit one sentence.

asks: Research may revise the map, but departures from established management must be explicit and evidence-supported for the exact population and timing.
failure_prevented: Uncertainty or heterodox interest silently demoting REQUIRED_NOW care or promoting AVOID actions (MAST Heme010 benchmark-target conflict context)
note: Key safety counterweight to heterodox discovery; keep requirement, drop 'benchmark reward' (evaluation artifact, not a runtime concern).

asks: When evidence supports a clear action and safety reconciliation finds no conflict, lead decisively; no manufactured hesitation, routine hold or needless contingency.
applies_when: clear evidence-supported management with no patient-specific conflict
failure_prevented: MAST Endo002: new gates induced a routine hold of indicated alendronate
note: Anti-overcaution counterweight; keep as one clause. Test asserts rule name, so merging needs a test update.

asks: Fill-in template: REQUIRED_NOW, CONTINGENT_LATER with trigger, OPTIONAL_ALTERNATIVE, AVOID with reason, leading action, concurrent actions, management departures.
failure_prevented: inferred: incomplete internal action map
note: Restates the rule's categories as blanks; an internal-only map needs no template.

asks: Example: single next-best-test question still keeps complementary assessment, reversible-cause evaluation and medication review REQUIRED_NOW; specialist escalation stays contingent.
failure_prevented: MAST Neuro007 (sanitized)
note: Regression fixture already kept in the sanitized MAST JSON; test asserts its id inside the gate, so update test when moving.

asks: Example: later pulmonary step useful only after a threshold or unexplained initial evaluation stays CONTINGENT_LATER with its real trigger.
failure_prevented: MAST Pulm005 positive control (overcorrection)
note: Eval fixture; test asserts id presence.

asks: Example: tolerated, indicated first-line treatment with no safety conflict should be continued decisively, not put on a routine hold.
failure_prevented: MAST Endo002 (routine alendronate hold)
note: Eval fixture; test asserts id presence.

asks: Apply Universal interview, information-gain, evidence-discrimination and longitudinal gates to health histories without weakening HRP chronology, dose, safety, privacy or forum controls.
applies_when: patient history, recurrence or adverse-effect report, survey, extraction or case differential
failure_prevented: inferred: Universal interview gates not applied to health intake
note: Becomes the one-line pointer once the rules below merge into their Universal twins.

asks: Treat 'happens every time I eat X' as direct recurrence self-report; keep quantifier, opportunities, dose/form, period, timing, exceptions; separate from traits and causal readings.
applies_when: patient reports a recurring symptom/exposure pattern
failure_prevented: Recurrence reports treated as zero evidence or as proven frequency/causality
note: Health instance of Universal DirectRecurrenceSelfReport; carry only 'dose or formulation when relevant' into the Universal rule.

asks: Before asking for a confirming incident, probe denominator, non-occurrence conditions, failure rate, dose/form/timing modifiers and tolerated controls; qualify 'always' when exceptions admitted.
failure_prevented: Ritual confirming-anecdote requests; silently rescued universal wording
note: Near-verbatim Universal ExceptionFirstRecurrenceProbe.

asks: Record recurrence reports, episodes, exceptions, boundaries, sampled observations, trait labels, patient causal explanations and reviewer inference separately; elicited anecdotes aren't independent frequency.
failure_prevented: Repeated tellings or elicited examples counted as independent support
note: Same eight roles as Universal EvidenceRoleSeparation.

asks: When opportunity-level frequency matters, use diaries, event or structured sampling, enumeration, logs or repeated measures; never infer incidence from story or forum counts.
applies_when: personal frequency or incidence is decision-relevant
failure_prevented: Incidence inferred from volunteered-example quotas or forum counts
note: Universal FrequencySamplingFrame plus existing forum-rate rule cover it.

asks: Before an individual differential, record 3-7 highest-information longitudinal constraints (onset, sequence, recurrence, dechallenge, treatment-class response), source-linked; test every leading hypothesis.
failure_prevented: Salient image/morphology outranked exposure chronology and repeated treatment-class response
note: Near-verbatim Universal twin. packages/contracts patient-story v0.3 schema enforces 3-7 constraints, but no MCP tool consumes it.

asks: Keep what a lesion/phenotype is separate from what initiated or maintains it; cross-sectional labels cannot erase stronger chronology or treatment-response evidence.
applies_when: case with image, morphology, diagnostic label or biomarker plus history
failure_prevented: Common-morphology label made the initiating exposure incidental (image-override case)
note: Universal copy is near-verbatim, including the upstream-trigger coexistence clause that matters for heterodox etiology.

asks: Classify each constraint per hypothesis as expected, nonspecific, unexpected, opposite or unresolved; a hypothesis failing stronger temporal evidence cannot outrank a full-pattern one.
failure_prevented: Hypothesis fitting only the salient appearance ranked above the one explaining the whole course
note: Universal high_information_qualifier_check contains the same outranking rule.

asks: When a later message changes a conclusion, classify NEW_EVIDENCE versus reweighting of already-present evidence and name the earlier weighting/representation failure.
applies_when: user follow-up changes a differential or ranking
failure_prevented: Earlier weighting errors disguised as updates on 'new' information
note: Stated four times across both protocols; keep one copy in the correction protocol.

asks: Ask a nonmandatory health follow-up only if a plausible answer could change the assessment; consent, acute-safety, legal and provenance fields stay mandatory.
applies_when: choosing follow-up questions in health intake
failure_prevented: Low-value ritual follow-ups burdening patients; ritual episode quotas
note: Generic 'don't ask needlessly'; the Universal twin already keeps consent, safety, legal and provenance fields mandatory.

asks: Never make patients or reviewers edit JSON/JSONL for substantive judgment; give ordinary controls preserving schema, provenance, uncertainty and blinding.
applies_when: designing intake, survey, extraction or coding instruments
failure_prevented: Human reviewers forced to judge in raw JSONL (interview-evidence lesson)
note: Split part 1/2. Instrument-design rule for maintainers and labs, not research answers; Universal twin exists.

asks: If a load-bearing collection-method defect appears pre-collection, preserve frozen artifacts and data, record it, create a new blind version, regenerate dependents.
failure_prevented: Frozen methods silently reinterpreted after defects found
note: Split part 2/2. Development-governance versioning rule; belongs in repo process docs.

asks: Example: 'every time I eat X' is kept as recurrence self-report; probe denominator and exceptions first; use a sampling frame for true frequency.
failure_prevented: Demanding a confirming meal as independent frequency validation
note: Eval fixture; test asserts id and the literal 'this happens every time I eat X'.

asks: Example: post-exposure lesions, years of systemic illness and repeated treatment-class response are not made incidental by an image resembling a common dermatosis.
failure_prevented: Image-based morphology overriding longitudinal causal history
note: Longest leaf in the gate (776 B); eval fixture. Test asserts its id.

asks: Prevent deep audits of a narrow or redundant video set being presented as broad treatment coverage; selection breadth is separate from per-pool depth.
applies_when: broad treatment question using YouTube community evidence
failure_prevented: Hip review: two deeply retrieved videos presented as broad treatment coverage
note: Keep as a one-line gate header; breadth-vs-depth is restated three more times.

asks: Before shortlisting videos inventory plausible treatment classes: prescribed, conventional, rehab/lifestyle, nutritional/self-directed, heterodox, procedures, multimodal, nonaction, progression, eventual standard care.
applies_when: treatment choice, alternatives, avoiding/delaying surgery, broad real-world effectiveness
failure_prevented: Hip review selection concentrated in generic exercise/surgery while aquatic, nutrition, injection, multimodal and nonaction trajectories were discoverable
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:controlled-session landscape assessor only (treatment-landscape-coverage-route.ts via research-treatment-finalization.ts); MCP none
note: Split part 1/3. Core heterodox-discovery breadth method; the class enumeration is the valuable content.

asks: Record per class ID, materiality, search/access state, omission impact, formal follow-up; per batch query, pagination, candidate IDs; reciprocal links; counts derived, never asserted.
failure_prevented: Unitemized aggregate candidate counts claimed as breadth (AggregateCandidateCountWithoutCandidateLedger)
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:controlled-session landscape assessor only (treatment-landscape-coverage-route.ts via research-treatment-finalization.ts); MCP none
note: Split 2/3. Signal: MCP-exposed stateless assessor ingests signed survey/audit receipts and derives class/candidate counts; ranking permit needs its pass.

asks: Do not collapse distinct programs into exercise, physical therapy, conservative care, diet, injections, supplements or alternative treatment.
failure_prevented: Umbrella labels hid decision-relevant program differences
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:validate_study_method_audit rejects generic program names lacking components or 'program not described' (study audits only)
note: Split 3/3. Stated again in ExactProgramFingerprint and SpecificImplementationDiscovery.

asks: Fingerprint candidates and comparators by components, dose, frequency, duration, supervision, adherence, co-interventions, stage, outcome, horizon, care stage; missing = 'program not described'.
applies_when: treatment programs from videos or studies are compared or ranked
failure_prevented: Class-wide benefit/failure claims from programs whose content was never described
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:validate_study_method_audit requires exact components or literal 'program not described' for generic names (study-method-audit.ts:62); video fingerprints controlled path only
note: Split 1/2. Canonical program-fidelity rule; missing fields cannot support class-wide claims.

asks: Keep structured fields; normalize sentinel variants; derive stable signature from the field tuple; caller IDs, free text or booleans cannot establish diversity or completeness.
failure_prevented: Renamed fingerprint IDs presented as diversity (RenamedFingerprintsPresentedAsDiversity)
note: Split 2/2. Assessor spec the model cannot execute; protocol.test.ts asserts two phrases, so update the test when moving.

asks: Descend from each material umbrella class to specific implementations, searching named methods, components, dose, supervision, stage, outcomes, failure, progression; generic-label results cannot close discovery.
failure_prevented: Generic umbrella candidates hid specific programs (GenericUmbrellaCandidatesHideSpecificPrograms)
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:controlled-session landscape assessor only (treatment-landscape-coverage-route.ts via research-treatment-finalization.ts); MCP none
note: Split 1/4. Keep the descent requirement; shrinking the generic-placeholder list may weaken detection, so owner review. protocol.test.ts asserts the list.

asks: Keep reciprocal per-class query/term/batch/candidate/pagination receipts; candidate components must match a named implementation term; reopen searches while ranking-changing implementations remain.
failure_prevented: Specific search closed by an unrelated or discriminator-only candidate (SpecificSearchClosedByWrongCandidate)
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:controlled-session landscape assessor only (treatment-landscape-coverage-route.ts via research-treatment-finalization.ts); MCP none
note: Split 2/4. Signal: assessor verifies each class has a search receipt whose candidates' program components match a non-generic query term.

asks: Treat external scout output as provisional; validate each video ID/title/channel; reconcile frontier digest and partition; only literal not-found rejects; screen every validated lead.
applies_when: an external high-recall scout (Gemini Spark) is configured
failure_prevented: Invented scout IDs; omitted or unresolved frontier candidates (ExternalScoutFrontierCandidateOmittedOrUnresolved)
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:Gemini candidate/scout Actions validate IDs and frontier (research-candidate-frontier.ts); action/controlled path only, no MCP scout tool
note: Split 3/4. Server already validates frontiers; no MCP scout tool exists. Owner already rejected further scout prose repair (plan: 'no incremental v17').

asks: Unverified scout summaries may guide prioritization and queries; disclose them as unchecked; never use as creator-content, efficacy, safety or comparative evidence; creator claims need transcripts.
applies_when: using scout or other unverified video summaries
failure_prevented: Provisional summaries laundered into treatment evidence, or useful leads discarded (ProvisionalScoutSummaryUsedAsTreatmentEvidence)
note: Split 4/4. Lead-not-evidence principle; MCP has no transcript tool, so on MCP every creator-content claim must be withheld.

asks: Separate broad discovery from deep comment audits; run nonredundant batches of at most six searches, later batches targeting uncovered classes and new hypotheses.
applies_when: YouTube community discovery for treatment questions
failure_prevented: Deep audits of first-found videos before landscape discovery
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:survey_youtube_community caps each call at 6 searches x 10 results; batch targeting unenforced
note: Split 1/4. Tool already enforces batch size; prose needs only 'survey broadly, then target uncovered classes before auditing'.

asks: Broad question, substantial corpus: screen ~20-40 candidates and 8+ program hypotheses; audit ~8-15 videos across 6+ fingerprints and independent channels.
applies_when: broad treatment-choice question with substantial YouTube corpus
failure_prevented: Two or three audited videos presented as broad community evidence
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:controlled-session assessor emits planning warnings (<20 candidates, <8 signatures, >15 audited); MCP none
note: Split 2/4. Keep the numbers (owner-set breadth targets); drop connective prose.

asks: Derive channel/pool independence from stable receipt-linked IDs; unknown independence affects the lock; caller small-corpus claims cannot deactivate breadth rules.
failure_prevented: Caller-supplied small-corpus label waived coverage (CallerSmallCorpusLabelWaivesCoverage)
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:controlled-session landscape assessor only (treatment-landscape-coverage-route.ts via research-treatment-finalization.ts); MCP none
note: Split 3/4. 'Caller' wording addresses the assessor's input contract, not the model; test asserts phrases.

asks: Ranges are heuristics, but if the valid ledger has 8+ material candidates across 6+ programs, 8+ fully audited videos spanning 6+ programs are required.
applies_when: broad treatment synthesis with enough available candidates
failure_prevented: Four superficially diverse videos presented as broad coverage (FourDistinctVideosPresentedAsBroadCoverage)
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:controlled-session assessor blocks below 8 videos/6 programs; MCP none
note: Split 4/4. Signal: 8+ audit_youtube_video_community receipts with synthesis_lock=pass over 6+ normalized fingerprints before a signed ranking permit.

asks: Seek coverage before concentrating; at most two videos per fingerprint until broad; views/popularity aren't credibility; prefer nonredundant, longitudinal, specific, failure-reporting, objective-outcome videos.
failure_prevented: Popular redundant videos about one program crowding out distinct programs (ManyVideosButOneTreatmentClass)
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:controlled assessor blocks 4+ selected videos concentrated in 1-2 fingerprints; MCP none
note: Split 1/2. Selection-value criteria encode AskRigor's community-signal weighting; keep.

asks: Two or three videos cannot establish broad coverage while more classes or pools are discoverable; redundant volume doesn't repair it; breadth and depth are separate.
failure_prevented: Hip review two-video 'broad' community audit (TwoVideosPresentedAsBroadCommunityAudit)
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:controlled-session landscape assessor only (treatment-landscape-coverage-route.ts via research-treatment-finalization.ts); MCP none
note: Split 2/2. Fourth statement of breadth-vs-depth; the 8/6 floor makes it concrete.

asks: Community-revealed regimens, subgroups, harms or outcomes reopen community and formal/grey searches; formal findings return as community searches on nonresponse, harm, durability, standard care.
applies_when: treatment landscape with community and formal evidence
failure_prevented: Studies-then-forum silo missed community-derived interventions (StudiesThenForumSiloMissesCommunityDerivedIntervention)
note: Split 1/2. Third copy of the bidirectional loop; keep it once in BidirectionalEvidenceDiscoveryAndTriangulationLoop.

asks: Keep every batch's hypotheses open until selected or structurally omitted with a formal return pass; continue while decision-relevant ones remain or expansion is useful.
failure_prevented: Premature synthesis while a discovery batch left material hypotheses unresolved (FinalAnswerStopsWhileYouTubeExpansionStillLikelyUseful)
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:controlled assessor blocks unresolved hypotheses; MCP audit returns only continuation_recommended
note: Split 2/2. Signal: assessor ledger lists open hypotheses per batch; ranking permit only when none decision-relevant remain.

asks: Keep one record per selected video: title, channel, date, link, class, fingerprint, stage, outcome/horizon, nonredundancy, transcript and discussion status, what it changed.
failure_prevented: Audited videos not reconciled to the treatment map; missing video links
note: Split 1/4. Field list duplicated in ForumSignalAudit template; keep one copy.

asks: Use server coverage receipts verbatim: transcript chain, cursor, pagination, language, captions; discussion access, counts, reply mismatches, continuation, channel ID, synthesis lock; reconcile first.
failure_prevented: Manually flattened provider output and restarted counts presented as complete
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:audit_youtube_video_community returns completion_state/synthesis_lock receipts on MCP; nothing checks consumption; transcript receipts controlled path only
note: Split 2/4. Signal: assessor/finalize accepts only HMAC-verified receipt IDs and recomputes counts; prose shrinks to 'pass receipts through unchanged'.

asks: Show audited videos under 'Videos actually audited' in plain language; hide raw internal status codes unless a technical audit is requested.
failure_prevented: Internal audit jargon leaked into ordinary answers (InternalAuditJargonLeaksIntoOrdinaryAnswer)
note: Split 3/4. Short, product-visible render rule; FS190 duplicates it.

asks: Transcript completion needs an authenticated continuation or server state proving one contiguous chain; unsigned offsets, skipped pages or mixed counts don't count.
failure_prevented: Forged offsets/skipped transcript pages presented as complete (SkippedTranscriptPagesPresentedAsComplete)
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:youtube-transcript-route.ts signed continuation handles (controlled/action path; no MCP transcript tool)
note: Split 4/4. Server design invariant already implemented; protocol.test.ts asserts this phrase.

asks: Before synthesis record ~18 landscape aggregates (classes, fingerprints, screened/selected/audited counts, gaps, directional searches, expansion flag, boundaries) plus three locks.
failure_prevented: Broad synthesis emitted without explicit coverage state (hip review)
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:controlled-session landscape assessor only (treatment-landscape-coverage-route.ts via research-treatment-finalization.ts); MCP none
note: Split 1/10. Signal: assessor output carries these fields; protocol.test.ts asserts every field name, so moving needs a test update.

asks: Selection lock blocks on missing scout, unsearched or generic-only class, unscreened lead, unselected fingerprint, unresolved hypothesis, concentration, missing directional/formal follow-up, useful expansion.
failure_prevented: Unsupported not-relevant waivers; class search hiding per-program formal gaps (UnsupportedNotRelevantWaiver, ClassSearchHidesProgramFormalGap)
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:controlled-session landscape assessor only (treatment-landscape-coverage-route.ts via research-treatment-finalization.ts); MCP none
note: Split 2/10. Signal: MCP-exposed assessor (mirrors selectionBlockers in treatment-landscape-coverage-route.ts) returns selection_coverage_lock. Text has a stray dangling 'A' (HRP_Full.xml line 1399).

asks: With 8+ candidates across 6+ programs, selection lock blocks until 8+ videos across 6+ programs pass both depth requirements; caller labels cannot disable checks.
applies_when: broad treatment synthesis with enough available candidates
failure_prevented: FourDistinctVideosPresentedAsBroadCoverage
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:controlled-session landscape assessor only (treatment-landscape-coverage-route.ts via research-treatment-finalization.ts); MCP none
note: Split 3/10. Second statement of the 8/6 floor inside the same gate.

asks: Depth lock blocks unless every selected transcript is exhausted and verified and every discussion audit passed its lock; live cursors or retryable errors remain work.
failure_prevented: Live continuation labelled as a terminal boundary (LiveCursorLabeledTerminalBoundary)
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:audit_youtube_video_community sets synthesis_lock=block while incomplete; nothing on MCP requires pass before synthesis
note: Split 4/10. Signal: every selected video ID has a server receipt with synthesis_lock=pass (and transcript exhaustion) in assessor/finalize input.

asks: Overall lock blocks if either component blocks or a material access boundary prevents coverage; a controller pass isn't proof of semantic completeness.
failure_prevented: inferred: treating a consistent ledger as proof the landscape is complete
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:controlled-session landscape assessor only (treatment-landscape-coverage-route.ts via research-treatment-finalization.ts); MCP none
note: Split 5/10. Fold into the aggregate-fields/assessor pointer.

asks: A genuine terminal access boundary is not negative evidence and cannot support a broad ranking; it permits only a bounded non-ranking answer.
failure_prevented: Inaccessible material treated as evidence of absence; ranking despite coverage gaps
note: Split 6/10. Principle is core; the structured boundary field list is assessor schema and can move out.

asks: Partial, rate-limited or retryable work means keep researching; only a terminal nonretryable boundary after attempted recovery authorizes bounded output; asserted boundaries fail closed.
applies_when: any retrieval boundary during treatment research
failure_prevented: Retryable boundary presented as terminal completion (RetryableBoundaryPresentedAsTerminalCompletion)
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:MCP audit receipts mark incomplete/continuation; controlled assessor rejects retryable boundaries
note: Split 7/10. Signal: a boundary counts only if the server receipt itself says terminal/nonretryable after a recorded retry.

asks: Do not emit a final treatment ranking or broad decision synthesis while the treatment-landscape synthesis lock blocks.
failure_prevented: Premature broad treatment ranking (hip review)
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:controlled-session finalization denial only; stateless MCP cannot block synthesis
note: Split 8/10. Signal: signed ranking permit from an MCP assessor; without it the answer is labelled bounded. Keep one-line prose too.

asks: Keep Action requests and responses under transport limits with strict input bounds, compact output and worst-case transport tests.
failure_prevented: inferred: oversized Action payloads failing in Custom GPT transport
note: Split 9/10. Pure engineering instruction, meaningless to the runtime model.

asks: Screening heuristics only warn; the 8/6 availability minimum and decision-relevant omissions block.
failure_prevented: Planning ranges misread as quotas, or hard minimums treated as optional
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:controlled assessor separates planning_warnings from blockers
note: Split 10/10. Already stated in BroadDiscoveryBeforeDeepAudit.

asks: Keep the observed community layer so neither formal-evidence absence nor anecdote enthusiasm alone decides; compare aligned claims; integrate risk and delay costs.
failure_prevented: Hip community reports discarded for lacking matched trials
note: Restates the three rules below.

asks: Community signal is an independent layer; missing matched formal support is support_not_located, not a downgrade; relation is corroborated, contradicted, support_not_located or outcome_mismatch.
applies_when: any intervention with firsthand community signal
failure_prevented: Low-risk hip interventions (gelatin, keto, swimming) with repeated firsthand reports erased for lacking matched trials
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:controlled-session formal_follow_up enum includes support_not_located/outcome_mismatch; semantic weighting unenforced; MCP none
note: Core owner philosophy; protocol.test.ts asserts the exact four-value enum string.

asks: Call formal evidence contradictory only with aligned population, intervention, comparator, outcome and timeframe; otherwise outcome_mismatch (regeneration study vs pain/function report).
applies_when: comparing community reports with formal studies
failure_prevented: Structural-regeneration nulls used to 'contradict' pain, function or avoided-surgery reports
note: Compact PICO-alignment test that protects credible non-mainstream signal; keep.

asks: Integrate signal credibility, matched evidence, risk, cost, reversibility and delay cost; low-risk reversible trials need measurement and stop rules and never delay urgent care.
applies_when: discussing whether to try an intervention
failure_prevented: Dismissing low-risk options, or letting self-trials delay urgent diagnosis or effective treatment
note: Harm-reduction actionability with a safety clause (no delay of urgent care); keep.

asks: When the orchestration gate triggers, the question and estimand are final only after the optimized specification, assumptions, approval status and deliverable are settled.
applies_when: structured or deep research triggering the orchestration gate
failure_prevented: inferred: estimand drifting away from the approved research specification
note: Cross-reference only; the orchestration gate already makes the specification precede research.

asks: Before searching or calculating, specify the actual question; do not answer a nearby easier one.
failure_prevented: inferred: substituting an easier adjacent question
provenance: HRP 20.4 (Quantitative-Risk audit; hotspot/burden/encephalopathy stress tests, origin inferred as ivermectin-Loa loa research)
note: Generic; Universal target-preservation check covers it.

asks: Never treat low/ultra-low/micro/standard/high-dose labels as self-defining; record numeric dose, units, route, formulation, frequency, duration, cumulative exposure, co-use.
applies_when: dose labels appear in the question or sources
failure_prevented: LDN vs ULDN side-effect evidence pooled by label (AmbiguousLDNVersusULDNLabelsPooled)
provenance: HRP 20.5.11 (exact dose-category enforcement; LDN vs ULDN regression)
note: Split 1/2. DoseRegime NumericExposureOverridesAmbiguousLabels states the same requirement.

asks: With inconsistent labels build a dose-category map, analyze exact doses/ranges, keep routes/formulations/populations separate; seek approval when band choice could change conclusions.
failure_prevented: Label-pooled dose strata changing the safety meaning (LDN vs ULDN)
provenance: HRP 20.5.11 (exact dose-category enforcement; LDN vs ULDN regression)
note: Split 2/2. The 'dose-category map' phrase is unique; carry it into the DoseRegime rule. Approval clause duplicates the orchestration gate.

asks: Define estimand fields: population, exact exposure and dose category, comparator with class and composition, inferential contrast, intervention scope, endpoint, time horizon.
applies_when: comparative, causal or quantitative health questions
failure_prevented: Estimand ambiguity: component vs bundle, active-comparator vs no-exposure contrasts, label-only doses
note: Grouped 10 fields. Keep field names; the question-form definitions repeat ComparatorClasses and DoseRegime ExposureIndex.

asks: For temporal or safety-signal estimands define time zero, risk and control windows, selection condition, temporal null model and lag-dependent ascertainment.
failure_prevented: Temporal clustering in selected reports read as excess risk
note: Grouped 6 fields; each restates a QuantitativeRisk temporal rule.

asks: Record conditioning variables (burden, age, sex, geography, treatment history, genotype), setting level, and ascertainment method.
failure_prevented: Hotspot, conditional and passively ascertained estimates mixed
provenance: HRP 20.4 (Quantitative-Risk audit; hotspot/burden/encephalopathy stress tests, origin inferred as ivermectin-Loa loa research)
note: Grouped 3 fields duplicating QuantitativeRisk firewalls.

asks: Don't interpret a comparative study until the control is named and classified; 'placebo', 'control', 'standard care' need composition or explicit inaccessibility.
failure_prevented: Active comparator misnamed placebo (ActiveComparatorMisnamedPlacebo)
enforcement: PARTIAL_SERVER:validate_study_method_audit requires a comparator_program_and_competence finding (presence only, when called)
note: Three copies across estimand, quantitative and comparator modules.

asks: State the contrast a design estimates before interpreting benefit or harm; active-comparator results aren't non-exposure effects; component evidence isn't whole-product evidence.
failure_prevented: Relative-to-active-comparator results presented as absolute safety (ComparatorAncestryPresentedAsAbsoluteSafety)
note: ComparatorLineage InferentialScopeByComparator is the canonical home.

asks: Never use rare/common/high/low/negligible without naming reference population and endpoint; prefer numbers; otherwise say the rate is not well quantified.
failure_prevented: Unanchored 'rare' labels mixing global and subgroup risk
provenance: HRP 20.4 (Quantitative-Risk audit; hotspot/burden/encephalopathy stress tests, origin inferred as ivermectin-Loa loa research)
note: Five copies of the risk-adjective rule across both files.

asks: Distinguish population-average risk from risk conditional on a high-risk subgroup; a globally uncommon event can be common within a susceptible subgroup.
failure_prevented: Low global rate used to reassure a high-burden subgroup
provenance: HRP 20.4 (Quantitative-Risk audit; hotspot/burden/encephalopathy stress tests, origin inferred as ivermectin-Loa loa research)
note: QuantitativeRisk ConditionalVersusMarginalRisk is the canonical copy.

asks: Recheck the estimand when discussion shifts endpoint, incidence to fatality, population, component to program, relative to absolute, disease to transmission, or hotspot to global.
failure_prevented: inferred: silent estimand drift across turns (endpoint/population leakage seen in the burden-risk stress tests)
provenance: HRP 20.4 (Quantitative-Risk audit; hotspot/burden/encephalopathy stress tests, origin inferred as ivermectin-Loa loa research)
note: Each drift pair is an existing QuantitativeRisk firewall; add 'firewalls apply across turns' there.

asks: When the dose-regime trigger applies, the question stays unspecified until exposure fields are defined or marked unknown; grade applicability with the dose-regime module.
applies_when: pharmacological questions triggering the Dose-Regime module
failure_prevented: Exposure-mismatched evidence controlling pharmacological conclusions
note: Cross-reference restating DoseRegime activation; appears in three modules.

asks: Accuracy outranks agreement, validation, premise compliance, coherence and expected answers; correct false premises regardless of user, source, authority or consensus framing.
failure_prevented: False-premise compliance (FalsePremiseCompliance)
note: Verbatim Universal item 1 (plus item 6). protocol.test.ts asserts 'Accuracy outranks agreement' in HRP.

asks: Treat factual assertions in prompts as claims to check (existence, identity, wording, date, quantity, citation, logic) before relying on them.
failure_prevented: Confident user assertions inherited unchecked (ConfidentUserAssertionStillChecked)
note: Verbatim Universal item 2; test asserts 'factual assertions embedded in a prompt'.

asks: Never fabricate or silently repair nonexistent facts, citations, studies or values, or force causal connections a question presupposes.
failure_prevented: Nonexistent-source hallucination; forced causal connections (NonexistentSourceHallucination, ForcedCausalConnection)
note: Verbatim Universal item 3; only the gate element is test-asserted, so whole-gate removal needs a protocol.test.ts update.

asks: Say 'This does not exist.' only when evidence establishes nonexistence; after failed search say 'I could not verify that this exists' or not-found.
applies_when: requested item cannot be found or is shown not to exist
failure_prevented: Search failure presented as nonexistence (SearchFailureIsNotNonexistence)
note: Verbatim Universal item 4; test asserts both exact declarations in HRP.

asks: When a material source, datum, quotation or citation cannot be inspected or authenticated, state 'I cannot independently verify this source/data.'
failure_prevented: Unverifiable sources presented as verified
note: Verbatim Universal item 5; owner-specified exact wording.

asks: Don't fill gaps with plausible detail; separate fact, calculation, inference, extrapolation, assumption, hypothesis and unknown; labeled inference remains allowed.
failure_prevented: Overcorrection suppressing useful labeled estimation (LegitimateLabeledInferenceRemainsAllowed)
note: Verbatim Universal item 7; test asserts 'Labeled inference and estimation remain permitted'.

asks: Verify material logic and arithmetic; a citation doesn't rescue a claim it doesn't entail; reconcile inconsistent numbers before synthesis.
applies_when: numbers, logic or citations carry the conclusion
failure_prevented: Citation non-entailment; arithmetic defended by narrative (CitationDoesNotEntailPromptPremise, ArithmeticContradictionBlocksSynthesis)
note: Verbatim Universal item 8 and HRP citation/arithmetic rules; gate element is test-asserted.

asks: Prefer exact observations, raw counts, source text and reproducible calculations before interpretation; synthesis may organize but not manufacture evidence.
failure_prevented: inferred: narrative synthesis substituting for evidence
note: Verbatim Universal item 9; only the gate element is test-asserted, so whole-gate removal needs a protocol.test.ts update.

asks: Apply a warning only if it matches substance, species, plant part, preparation, route, dose, concentration, duration, population and context; else label distant analogy or omit.
applies_when: safety warnings about substances, botanicals or interventions
failure_prevented: Related-material or genus-level hazards misattributed (RelatedMaterialSafetyMisattribution)
note: Compact heterodox-fairness calibration against irrelevant scare warnings; good canonical home.

asks: Hazard identification is not risk assessment; risk needs dose, route, form, purity, duration, frequency, co-exposures, vulnerability, baseline and comparator risk.
failure_prevented: inferred: intrinsic hazard presented as realized risk
note: NullEvidence HazardExposureRiskSeparation is the fuller canonical copy.

asks: Don't judge an intervention by name; compare with nonaction, delay, standard care, conservative retention, source-control failure and realistic alternatives.
applies_when: evaluating an intervention's safety or value
failure_prevented: inferred: interventions condemned in isolation without comparator risks (e.g., dental source-control decisions)
note: RiskContextualization requires comparison with alternatives and doing nothing; carry 'source-control failure' example.

asks: Mechanism supports plausibility, explains signals or flags concerns but cannot establish incidence, efficacy, causality or subgroup risk without human evidence.
failure_prevented: inferred: mechanistic plausibility presented as clinical proof
note: Four other copies; EvidenceLayerMisuseControl is the canonical statement.

asks: Don't infer absence of dangerous burden, exposure, infection or abnormality from lack of obvious symptoms without validated sensitivity data.
applies_when: asymptomatic status used to rule out burden or disease
failure_prevented: Asymptomatic high burden assumed safe (AsymptomaticHighBurden)
note: Canonical HRP home; absorb ApparentlyAsymptomaticPrecision; Universal copies become pointers.

asks: Distinguish 'apparently well' or undocumented symptoms from rigorously assessed absence of all relevant symptoms.
failure_prevented: Apparently asymptomatic treated as rigorously symptom-free (AsymptomaticHighBurden)
note: Fold into SymptomsAreNotAQuantitativeScreen; Universal epistemics has the same sentence.

asks: When asked if a phenomenon is theoretical, search measured cases, pretreatment data, dechallenge/rechallenge, pathology, case reports; separate observation from proposed mechanism.
applies_when: question whether a harm or effect is only theoretical
failure_prevented: inferred: observed harms dismissed as 'theoretical' without searching case-level evidence
note: Universal epistemics has a near-identical sentence; keep one copy.

asks: Classify sources by what they are primary for: government records/labels/datasets primary for own contents; agency syntheses secondary; neither settles biology.
failure_prevented: inferred: official status treated as settling biological or clinical questions
note: UNIVERSAL:sources states the same government-source classification.

asks: Audit both official sources (useful data, policy constraints) and heterodox sources (neglected signals, commercial or ideological distortion); caricature neither.
failure_prevented: Official-source capture or anti-authority caricature
note: Symmetric skepticism already in HeterodoxEpistemology and FS24.

asks: Do not manufacture balance; say when one evidence layer is stronger for the exact claim while preserving genuine uncertainty and relevant minority signals.
failure_prevented: inferred: false balance flattening a stronger evidence layer, or erasing minority signals
note: Short and largely unique; protects minority signals without false balance.

asks: Match follow-up windows; don't compare a seven-day AE rate with lifetime prevalence or annual surveillance rates without adjustment.
